මේෂ, වෘෂභ, මිථුන ආදී ලග්න 12ටම මෙම ග්‍රහ මාරුව බලපාන අන්දම අපි විස්තරාත්මකව පැහැදිලි කර තිබෙනවා. ආදරය, විවාහය, රැකියාව, ව්‍යාපාර දියුණුව වගේම විදේශ ගමන් බලාපොරොත්තු වන ඔබට මෙම කාලය කෙබඳු වේදැයි මින් දැනගත හැක. ඔබේ ලග්නයට හිමි යහපත් ප්‍රතිඵල මෙන්ම අපල දුරු කරගැනීමට කළ යුතු සරලම ශාන්තිකර්මයක් වන කුරුල්ලන් නිදහස් කිරීම ගැනත් මෙහි සඳහන් වෙනවා. වීඩියෝව අවසන් වනතුරු රැඳී සිට ඔබේ අනාගතය සැලසුම් කරගන්න.

description:
මැගසින් බන්ධනාගාරයට මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය තොග සපයන නියාමක ඇල්ලූ පොලීසියේ රහස් සැලැස්ම...කුදලන් යන හැටි කැමරාවේ...


බොරැල්ල මැගසින් බන්ධනාගාරය තුළට මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය තොග වශයෙන් සපයන බව කියන බන්ධනාගාර නියාමකවරයෙකු රුපියල් ලක්ෂ 20කට අධික වටිනා මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය තොගයක් සමඟ අත්අඩංගුවට ගත් බව ගල්කිස්ස කොට්ඨාස අපරාධ විමර්ශන කාර්යාංශය සඳහන් කරයි.

එම සැකකරු සමඟ අයිස් මත්ද්‍රව‍ය ග්‍රෑම් 100ක් හා හොරෙයින් මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය ග්‍රෑම් 20ක් පොලිස් භාරයට ගෙන ඇත.

දෙහිවල වෛද්‍ය පාරේ පදිංචි 32 හැවිරිදි පුද්ගලයෙකු මෙම මත්ද්‍රව‍ය තොගය සමග ගල්කිස්ස ප්‍රදේශයේදී අත්අඩංගුවට ගැනීමෙන් අනතුරුව, ඔහුගෙන් සිදුකළ ප්‍රශ්න කිරීමේදී පවසා ඇත්තේ, මැගසින් බන්ධනාගාරයේ සිරදඬුවම් විඳින පුද්ගලයකු වට්ස්ඇප් දුරකථන ඇමතුමක් ඔස්සේ ලබා දුන් තොරතුරක් අනුව මෙම මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය පාර්සලය ලබාගත් බවය.

එම මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය පාර්සලය බොරැල්ල වනාත පාරේදී තවත් පුද්ගලයෙකුට ලබා දීමට නියමිත බව සැකකරුගෙන් තවදුරටත් අනාවරණය වී තිබේ. 

ඒ අනුව ගල්කිස්ස කොට්ඨාස අපරාධ විමර්ශන කාර්යාංශයේ ස්ථානාධිපති, ප්‍රධාන පොලිස් පරීක්ෂක නිලන්ත ගමගේ මහතා ඇතුළු කණ්ඩායමක් එම පුද්ගලයාද අත්අඩංගුවට ගැනීමට රහස් සැලැස්මක් ක්‍රියාත්මක කර තිබුණි. 

ඒ අනුව ක්‍රියාත්මක වූ පොලිස් නිලධාරීන් සැකකරු ළඟට පැමිණ මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය අඩංගු පාර්සලය ලබාගැනීමේ දී අදාළ පුද්ගලයාව අත්අඩංගුවට ගෙන ඇත.

එලෙස අත්අඩංගුවට ගෙන ඇත්තේ, බන්ධනාගාර ක්‍රීඩා ඇඳුමින් සැරසුණු පුද්ගලයෙකු වන අතර, ඔහු ඉකුත් ජනවාරි මාසයේ දී මැගසින් බන්ධනාගාරයේ සේවයට පැමිණි අයෙකු බවත් ඊට පෙර වැලිකඩ බන්ධනාගාරයේ සේවයේ නිරතව සිට ඇති බවත් බන්ධනාගාර ආරංචි මාර්ග සඳහන් කරයි.

ගල්කිස්ස කොට්ඨාස අපරාධ විමර්ශන කාර්යාංශය පරීක්ෂණ පවත්වයි.

title: What to do If the driver suddenly faints while driving 😫
description:
If the driver suddenly faints while the car is moving,
one wrong move can turn it into a deadly crash.

Most people think pulling the handbrake will stop the car.
But yanking it can lock the rear wheels
and send the vehicle spinning out of control.

In this video, learn what actually saves lives in that moment.

✅ Grab the steering wheel immediately and keep the car straight
✅ Move the driver’s foot off the accelerator
✅ Turn on the hazard lights or press the horn to warn others
✅ Gently press the brake pedal — don’t slam it
✅ Carefully guide the car to the side of the road

Panic makes accidents worse.
Control prevents them.

The goal isn’t to stop instantly.
It’s to slow down safely.

Because in those few seconds,
calm thinking is more powerful than speed.

description:
"Shadows Built on Breath" - A post-rock reverie on "The Noble Eightfold Path of cessationary factors" (අරිය අෂ්ට හංගික මාර්ගය | Ariya aṣṭha haṁgika mārgaya)

This post-rock reverie combines intimate high-tenor vocals with ambient, melancholic soundscapes, following a deeply spiritual lyrical path in both Sinhala and English. The track, titled "Shadows Built on Breath," explores the journey from worldly delusion to ultimate liberation through "The Noble Eightfold Path of cessationary factors" based on Buddhist teachings.

📝 Lyrics:
'Sammā diṭṭhiya' | සම්මා දිට්ඨිය | Unfettering view/belief/ideology 

දුකද, සමුදයද, එහි නිර් උදා වීම
නිර් උදා වෙන්ට නිසි මගෙහි පිලිපැදුම
පිළිබඳව පවතිනා නැණ පහළවීම
වෙතිය සම්මා වෙනා දිට්ටිය ලැබීම
Unfettering insight wakes to what true suffering means,
Its origin, its absolute end, behind the worldly scenes.
To walk the Noble Path to where all raging storms depart.
Unfettering view is fully born within a waking heart.

'Sammā diṭṭhiya' | සම්මා දිට්ඨිය | Unfettering view/belief/ideology 

මහා සාරයි සුභයි හිතාගෙන උන්නේ  
අනිස දුක අනත ලෝකයෙහි දැක ගන්නේ
මෙවන් ලෝකයේ සාරය කිමක් වන්නේ 
සං වීම මා වෙනා දිට්ටියෙහි ඉන්නේ  
I once believed this world was grand, auspicious, and sublime,
But now I see it's unfulfilling, punishing - a futile march of time.
What essence can be truly found within a world so blind?
This deep, unfettering view is what now operates my mind.

'Sammā saṁkappaya' | සම්මා සංකප්පය | Unfettering thinking 

වෛර ක්‍රෝධය හිංගි හිංසා කරමිනේ
මම මගේ කරගන්න තමයි රැක උන්නේ   
අයිතිවාසිකම් කියමින් කොහේ යන්නේ 
හිංසාව වෛර ඇල්මද දැන් නිවෙන්නේ 
I lived to strike and harm the world, in hatred and in rage,
Defending fields of "me and mine" within a mortal cage.
To what dark end do we demand to claim this passing ground?
I quench the fires of violence now; a deeper peace is found.

'Sammā vācāva' | සම්මා වාචාව |  Unfettering speech 

බොරු කියා කේළමෙන් රවටගෙන උන්නේ 
පරුස බස් දී ප්‍රලාපෙන් කාලේ ගෙවුනේ 
මුලාවක් පසුපසින් මොකට හති ලන්නේ 
කට නිසා නැහෙන්නට ඉඩ නොම දෙන්නේ
I spent my days deceiving minds with lies and bitter spite,
In harsh and empty, idle talk that wasted away the light.
Why pant with such exhaustion, chasing shadows built on breath?
I will not let this reckless tongue invite my ruin and death.

'Sammā kammantaya' | සම්මා කම්මන්තය | Unfettering action 

ප්‍රාණ ඝාතෙන් කුමක්දෝ ලබා ගන්නේ  
සොරකමින් කිනම් ලාභයක්දෝ වෙන්නේ   
සුන්දරයි සිතූ කාමය අමය කන්නේ 
කයෙන් සිදුවූ පාප කම් අන්ත වන්නේ 
What truly can be gained by taking down another’s breath?
What ultimate, real profit lies within the act of theft?
False lust, once thought so beautiful, is poison to the mind.
The sinful actions of the flesh are finally left behind.

'Sammā ājīvaya' | සම්මා ආජීවය | Unfettering livelihood 

ආශ්වාදයි මාර කියලයි කියන්නේ 
මගේ වසඟේ කියාමයි හිතා උන්නේ 
ලෝකයෙන් ලොකුම කොටහට නැහැ නැහෙන්නේ 
දහම් මග පුරවන්ට මයි දිවි ගෙවන්නේ  
They say that worldly pleasures are delightful and sublime,
And I lived thinking I was king of my own space and time.
I will no longer perish for a false and selfish gain.
I yield my life to walk the Path, away from fear and pain.

'Sammā vāyāmaya' | සම්මා වායාමය | Unfettering effort 

ජීවිතය දැන් තුරන් වෙයිදෝ නොදන්නේ 
ඊට කලියෙන් නිවෙන්නට විරිය ගන්නේ 
උපන් නූපන් අකුසලය ගෙවී යන්නේ
නූපන්න උපන් කුසලය වැඩී එන්නේ 
I do not know when this frail life will slip and vanish deep,
Before it does, I strive for peace, a vow I mean to keep.
I wash away unwholesome states, both born and yet to rise,
And cultivate the wholesome seeds - unbloomed, or bloomed to prize.

'Sammā satiya' | සම්මා සතිය | Unfettering mindfulness 

යථාවාදී ලෙසම සිහි එළඹ ඉන්නේ
සිතන කියනා කරන හැම දේ දකින්නේ 
නිවනටම සුදුසු දැයි හොඳින් තෝරන්නේ 
අන් සියලු දේ වටින්නැහැ වැට බඳින්නේ 
Remaining mindful, seeing things exactly as they are,
I watch each fleeting thought, word, deed - the witness from afar.
I search if they are worthy of Nirvana's sacred peace,
And build a fence against the trash to grant my mind release.

'Sammā samādhiya' | සම්මා සමාධිය | Unfettering concentration 

කෙමෙන් නැණ පිරිලා විදසුන් වැඩෙන්නේ  
නොඅල්ලනා නොගැටෙනා තැනටමයි යන්නේ 
කිසීම අරමුණක නැහැ සිත එල්බ ගන්නේ 
ආනන්තරික සමාධිය ලබා ගන්නේ 
As contemplation gathers power, waking insight blooms,
Far past the reach of all attachment, free from hatred's glooms.
No longer clinging to the ghosts of any passing object,
Unwavering, unconditional - Samādhi stands perfect.

'Sammā gnāṇaya' | සම්මා ඥාණය | Unfettering knowledge/insightfulness 
'Sammā vimuktiya' | සම්මා විමුක්තිය | Unfettering liberation 

සම්මා දිට්ටියේ මූල නැණ තව වැඩෙන්නේ 
අසාරයි ලොව හැම තැනම දුකක් වන්නේ 
උපනා සම්මා නැණින් අරි සස් දකින්නේ 
සම්මා විමුක්තියෙන් අරි මග පිරෙන්නේ
The root, unfettering view is now in full bloom,
Realizing this inessential world is only pain and gloom.
Through ripe, unfettering insight, the Noble Truths shine bright,
In ultimate, unfettering freedom, the Noble Path is complete.

description:
වත්තල ප්‍රදේශයේ හෝටලයක ඉකුත් ජූලි 23වැනිදා රාත්‍රියේ පැවති උපන්දින සාදයකට කඩාවැදී, වෙඩි ප්‍රහාරයක් එල්ලකර පුද්ගලයෙකු ඝාතනය කර ඉන්දියාවට පළා ගොස් සිටි සැකකරුවන් දෙදෙනෙකු කටුනායක ගුවන්තොටුපොළේදී අද (13) අත්අඩංගුවට ගනු ලැබීය.

අදාළ සිද්ධියෙන් පසු ඔවුන් දෙදෙනා බෝට්ටුවක් මගින් ඉන්දියාවට පලාගොස් තිබූ අතර, එහිදී එරට ආරක්ෂක අංශ මගීන් අත්අඩංගුවට ගෙන මෙරටට පිටුවහල් කර ඇත. වත්තල ප්‍රදේශයේ පදිංච්කරුවන්වන මෙම දෙදෙනා අතරින් එක් අයෙකු  30 හැවිරිදි වියේ පසුවන අයෙකු වන අතර, අනෙක් පුද්ගලයා 34 හැවිරිදි වියේ පසුවන අයෙක්ය.

ඔවුන් චෙන්නායි නුවර සිට කටුනායක ගුවන්තොටුපොළ වෙත එවා තිබූ අතර, ඒ සම්බන්ධයෙන් ඉන්දීය ආරක්ෂක අංශ කටුනායක ගුවන්තොටුපොළ අපරාධ පරීෂණ දෙපාර්තමේන්තු නිලධාරීන් දැනුවත් කර තිබී ඇත. ඒ අනුව සැකකරුවන් දෙදෙනා පැමිණි ගුවන් යානය කටුනායකට පැමිණීමෙන් අනතුරුව අත්අඩංගුවට ගනු ලැබීය.

අපරාධ පරීක්ෂණ දෙපාර්තමේන්තු නිලධාරීන් විසින් ප්‍රකාශ සටහන් කර ගැනීමෙන් පසු, සැකකරුවන් දෙදෙනා වැඩිදුර විමර්ශන කටයුතු සඳහා දැඩි ආරක්ෂාව යටතේ බස්නාහිර පළාත් උතුර අපරාධ කොට්ඨාශය වෙත රැගෙන යාමට පියවර ගෙන තිබුණි.

title: ♫♪ Filled with the power of perfections ♫♪ (අනන්ත පාරමිතා බල සපිරූ) An Ethereal Liquid Folk Hymn ♫♪
description:
♫♪ Filled with the power of boundless perfections ♫♪ (අනන්ත පාරමිතා බල සපිරූ )-  An Ethereal Liquid Folk Hymn on the Power of Perfections
✨ "The Boundless Flood of Virtue" (An Ethereal Liquid Folk Hymn) ✨

Immerse yourself in a serene, fluid chronicle of sovereign truth and protective power. This track is an alternative cinematic production—blending the cascading textures of ethereal liquid folk and new age ambient pop with rolling river rhythms, acoustic harp glissandos, and fluid melodic synthesizer pads.

The lyrics vividly detail the immense power and defensive majesty of the Buddha’s accumulated Perfections (Pāramitā). The composition traces vital moments across the historical text: from the Great Renunciation at the banks of the River Anoma to the dissolving of the malefic magical chains that snared the Venerable Ananda. It reaches an absolute peak by illustrating the shattering of Mara's legions beneath the Bodhi tree, showing how the Great Bodhisattva rejected a thousand-fold sweetness of temptation to conquer cosmic night. It concludes with a powerful, protective blessing over the global community dedicated to preserving the Dhamma.

If this inspiring and deeply moving fluid hymn brings a sense of protective shelter or peace to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with fellow seekers on the path. ☸️🌊🪷🛡️

---
📖 LYRICS

The Boundless Flood of Virtue (අනන්ත පාරමිතා බල සපිරූ)

Filled with the power of boundless perfections deep,
Twenty-four Buddha Fathers their holy vigils keep.
Like a majestic, joyful flood of water grand,
Who can equal their virtue across the cosmic land?
අනන්ත පාරමිතා බල සපිරූ, සූවිසි උත්තම බුදුන් පියවරූ
නන්දනීය ජලකඳ වන් මහරූ, ගුණයෙන් බලයෙන් සම වෙද කවුරූ

Bearing bowls and robes by Anoma's river bank,
Fulfilling great perfections above all worldly rank.
As those Great Beings abode in supreme holiness,
Malefic bonds are severed by their divine success.
පාරමි ජලකඳ උතුමන් සපිරූ, අනෝම ගංතෙර පාත්‍ර සිව්රූ
දරමින් උතුමන් වැඩහුන් අයුරූ, මහිමෙන් බිඳෙනා බන්ධන රුදුරූ

Though Ananda the treasury of Dhamma fell a prey,
Snared by a cruel spell upon his righteous way.
The Lord Buddha dissolved those toxic chains of spite,
By the supreme power of Dhamma’s noble might.
දම් ගබඩාවකි සත් දම් පැතිරූ, අනඳ තෙරුන් වශියට විය ගොදුරූ
බුදුහිමි එම සියළුම බැමි නපුරූ, දම් අනුභාවෙන් වැනසූ අයුරූ

Unleashed by the legions of Mara’s darkest hour,
A reign of terror rose with hundred millions tower.
Shattering and leveling every wall of grief,
The Bodhisattva won the Buddhahood’s relief.
භීෂණයකි මර සේනා පැතිරූ, දස කෝටිය සහසක් බැමි පවුරූ
සියල්ල සිඳ බිඳ බෝසත් මහරූ, බලයෙන් බුදු බව ලැබගත් අයුරූ

As the sovereign majesty of Buddha-power grew,
Fulfilling noble paths that worldlings never knew.
He never steered His chariot toward the sensual fire,
Spurning a thousand temptations of desire.
බුදු බල මහිමය ගෙනදෙන අයුරූ, පාරමිතා පුරනා කල මහරූ
කම් අස්සාදය වෙත රිය නොකෙරූ, ඉඩ ලද දහස් ගණන් වර මියුරූ 

Summoning His courage and radiating light,
He fulfilled perfections to conquer cosmic night.
Through the noble influence of such virtues so grand,
May blessings fall upon the Sasana’s devoted band.
වෙර වීරිය ගෙන ඔද තෙද පැතිරූ, පෙරුම් පුරන්නට බුදු වෙන අයුරූ
ඒ බලයේ අනුභාවෙන් මහරූ, සෙත වෙත සැමටම සසුනට මිතුරූ 

May blessings fall upon the Sasana’s devoted band.
සෙත වෙත සැමටම සසුනට මිතුරූ

description:
✍  Rajamale – Moray Estate Trail for climbing Adam's Peak
[ Difficulty Level: modarate+ | Approximate time: 3-5 hours ]
The starting point of the trail is the upper part of Rajamale, the highest point of the famous Murray Estate. To reach Rajamale you need to travel about 5 km from Nallathanniya. This distance can be reached by a vehicle with a high ground clearance since this is quite a rough track.
The specialty of this route is that it is the only Sri Pada route that can be traveled at the shortest distance and at the lowest height. When traveling from Nallathanniya to Rajamale, you can travel up to a height of 1610 meters above sea level by vehicle. The height of the hike is about 640 meters. Considering the distance, the trail is a small distance of about 4 kilometers.
After starting the journey from Rajamale, one has to travel through a forest road. The trail is mostly through a plain and the journey is along quite an easy path. Unlike other routes, there are very limited streams to get water here, so it is extremely important to carry enough water with you.
After traveling about 2 kilometers, you will find Sandagalathenna. It is a very beautiful large stone plateau and you could get a fantastic view of the Sri Pada from this rock.
Then one has to walk along a slightly higher slope and after traveling for about a kilometer it joins the Hatton Nallathanniya road.

title: Something Unprecedented Is Happening... Women Want Girls
description:
Have you noticed something that would have been almost unimaginable just a generation ago?

Across social media and in conversations around the world, more women are openly expressing that they hope for daughters rather than sons. Historically, many cultures celebrated the birth of boys above girls. Today, that conversation appears to be shifting.

Is this simply a social media trend? Is it rooted in changing cultural expectations? Could it reflect concerns about raising boys in today’s world, or is it something deeper?

In this video, we’re exploring the historical reversal, the cultural conversations surrounding it, and the different explanations people are offering. We’ll look at the perspectives of women, men, psychology, history, and even what we know, and don’t know, from biology and evolutionary theory.

This isn’t about hating boys or devaluing sons. It’s about asking why this conversation is happening now and what it may reveal about changing relationships, parenthood, and society itself.

Join the discussion below. Do you think this is a temporary trend, or the beginning of a much larger cultural shift?

title: The FINAL STRAW was NEVER THE PROBLEM
description:
⸻

What if the end of a marriage wasn’t caused by one catastrophic event… but by hundreds of tiny ones?

Across social media, women are describing marriage as “death by 1,000 cuts.” It isn’t usually one forgotten anniversary or one argument that ends the relationship. It’s the daily pattern of feeling ignored, dismissed, unheard, overburdened, and emotionally alone.

Many women say they spent years communicating their needs, only to hear:

* “I’ll do it later.”
* “You’re overreacting.”
* “It’s not my job.”
* “It came out of nowhere.”

Meanwhile, many husbands are genuinely shocked when divorce papers arrive because they never recognized the weight of the countless small moments that accumulated over time.

In this episode, we’re unpacking:
• Why so many women say the “final straw” was never really the final problem.
• The emotional labor that often goes unseen.
• Weaponized incompetence and why it becomes so damaging over time.
• Why one partner may experience years of erosion while the other remembers only the last argument.
• Whether these conversations can help couples understand each other before it’s too late.

This isn’t about blaming all men or all women. It’s about exploring why so many relationships reach a breaking point after years of seemingly “small” issues that were anything but small to the person carrying them.

💬 Have you ever heard the phrase “death by 1,000 cuts?” Do you think it’s an accurate way to describe how some relationships end? Share your perspective respectfully in the comments.

If you enjoy thoughtful conversations about relationships, gender dynamics, culture, and the stories shaping today’s conversations, Like, Subscribe, and join the Nava Speaks community.

Casting away the human form of disease,

Witnessing how empty coarse defilements fade,
And piercing past the traps that lust has made—
May all beings find the Non-returner’s peace,
To walk into the light where miseries cease.
With the restless itch and sensual grip released,
May every living being be sublimely appeased.

description:
Samsung has officially launched its most powerful tablet yet—the Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra. As the successor to the highly praised Tab S9 Ultra, this new flagship redefines what a premium Android tablet can offer in terms of performance, productivity, creativity, and entertainment. Here’s a deep dive into everything you need to know about the Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra. 🧱 Design & Build Quality The Tab S10 Ultra is crafted with a premium Armor Aluminum frame and back, making it both durable and sleek. With a super-slim profile of just 5.4mm and weighing around 718g (Wi-Fi) or 723g (5G), it’s easy to carry and comfortable to use. It’s also IP68-certified, making it water- and dust-resistant—a rare feature in the tablet world. The tablet is available in two elegant colors: Moonstone Gray and Platinum Silver. Dimensions: 326.4 x 208.6 x 5.4 mm Weight: ~718 g Build: Glass front, aluminum frame/back IP rating: IP68 (1.5 m for 30 mins) 🖥 Display – Visual Brilliance Samsung has equipped the Tab S10 Ultra with a 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, offering stunning visuals and immersive experiences. Resolution: 2960 x 1848 pixels (~239 ppi) Refresh Rate: 120Hz adaptive Brightness & Features: HDR10+, Vision Booster, anti-reflective coating Screen-to-Body Ratio: ~90.7% Aspect Ratio: 16:10 Whether you’re editing content, watching movies, or gaming, this display provides incredible detail, deep blacks, and vibrant colors. ⚙ Performance & Platform Under the hood, the Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 9300+ chipset, manufactured using an advanced 4nm process. This chip delivers top-tier flagship performance and includes AI enhancements for Samsung’s new Galaxy AI tools. CPU: Octa-core (1x 3.25GHz Cortex-X4, 3x 2.85GHz Cortex-X4, 4x 2.0GHz Cortex-A720) GPU: Immortalis-G720 MC12 OS: Android 14 with One UI 6.1 (upgradable to Android 15 / One UI 7.0) AI Integration: Note Assist, Sketch to Image, Circle to Search, Live Translate, PDF Assist 💾 Memory & Storage Options The tablet supports multiple RAM and storage options, giving users flexibility based on their needs: RAM: 12 GB or 16 GB Internal Storage: 256 GB / 512 GB / 1 TB Expandable Storage: microSDXC (dedicated slot, up to 1.5 TB) This makes it ideal for professionals handling large files or creators working on high-res content. ✏ Productivity with S Pen & Galaxy AI The S Pen comes included in the box and is now even more powerful. It features Bluetooth support, ultra-low latency (2.8 ms), and a wide range of smart tools: Air Gestures & Commands Handwriting Recognition & Conversion Sketch to Image (AI-powered) Circle to Search DeX Mode: Wireless desktop-style experience 3D Map View: Integration with SmartThings for smart home visualization 📷 Cameras – Dual Front & Rear Samsung has equipped the Tab S10 Ultra with versatile dual-camera setups on both front and rear: Rear Cameras: 13 MP wide (f/2.0, autofocus) 8 MP ultrawide (f/2.2) Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30fps Features: LED flash, panorama, HDR Front Cameras: 12 MP wide (f/2.2) 12 MP ultrawide (120° FOV) Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30fps Ideal for: Video conferencing, vlogging, online classes 🔊 Audio & Entertainment Speakers: Quad stereo speakers tuned by AKG Surround Sound: Supports Dolby Atmos Headphone Jack: No (USB-C or wireless only) The audio experience is rich and immersive—perfect for streaming, gaming, or creative tasks. 📡 Connectivity & Networking Whether you opt for the Wi-Fi or 5G model, the Tab S10 Ultra supports cutting-edge connectivity: Wi-Fi: 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6e/7 Bluetooth: v5.3 USB: Type-C 3.2 Gen 1 GPS: Available in 5G variant NFC: Not supported 5G Support: Sub-6 GHz (SA/NSA) – cellular model only 🔋 Battery & Charging Samsung provides a massive 11,200mAh battery, optimized with power-efficient hardware and software. title: Why There is No 'E' Grades
description:
School grades look simple — A, B, C, D, and F.
But one letter is strangely missing.

The letter E used to exist in some grading systems long ago.
Students could actually receive an E instead of an F.

But in the 1930s, schools noticed a big problem.
Many students and parents believed E meant “Excellent.”

That confusion made report cards misleading.
So schools slowly removed the letter E from grading.

Instead, they replaced it with F, which had only one clear meaning… Failed.

It wasn’t about making grades harsher.
It was simply about making them impossible to misunderstand.

A small change in letters…
but one that shaped how millions of students understand success and failure today.

title: "What If Women Were Never Supposed To Keep Men?"
description:
For decades, women have been shamed with one phrase:

“That’s why you can’t keep a man.”

But where did this idea come from?

Across the natural world, females are not expected to spend their lives managing, controlling, entertaining, rehabilitating, or “keeping” males. Yet human women are often told that a man’s behavior, loyalty, happiness, emotional regulation, and even presence are somehow their responsibility.

In this episode, we’re unpacking one of the most common insults directed at women and asking a deeper question:

Were women ever supposed to “keep” men in the first place?

We’ll explore the social conditioning behind this expectation, how women became burdened with the role of relationship manager, and why so many women are being blamed for outcomes that were never fully within their control.

If a man leaves, cheats, withdraws, refuses to contribute, or simply chooses a different path, why is the first question often:

“What did SHE do wrong?”

From marriage and dating to culture and gender expectations, this conversation challenges the idea that women are responsible for maintaining the presence and behavior of another adult human being.

Maybe the problem isn’t that women can’t keep men.

Maybe the problem is that women were taught they were supposed to.

💬 Join the conversation below:

* Have you ever been told you couldn’t “keep a man”?
* Where do you think this expectation comes from?
* Is this standard applied fairly?

This new backend isn’t just an update—it’s a transformation designed to streamline your workflow while maintaining the tools you know and love.

Just like an incense stick that slowly burns to nought,
I’ll spread the Dhamma's fragrance through every word and thought.
Awakening my mind to stay serene and bright,
I’ll dwell within the bliss of meditative light.
Honest in body, speech, and mind, I will endure,
Burning defilements down, to gain the Samsara's cure.

Each single drop of oil that feeds the burning wick, 
Ignites a passing spark that fades away so quick. 
These continuing sparks deceive, appearing as a flame, 
Just as a stream of moments builds our life's false name. 
No lasting 'self' endures within this mortal strife, 
The Lord Sage made it clear: there is no lasting life.

title: August 7th & 8th | Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei” | Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com
description:
Few More Days!!🤩 Grab your tickets now❤️

August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. Late entry may be restricted during the performance. No outside food or beverages permitted. Recording and flash photography may be restricted.

✍ Battle of Mullaitivu (1996)
The final battle between the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) and the Sri Lankan Army in Mullaithivu marked a significant turning point in the decades-long conflict in Sri Lanka. As the Sri Lankan government intensified its military operations against the LTTE in the early 2000s, Mullaithivu became a crucial battleground.

In the closing stages of the conflict, the LTTE, led by Velupillai Prabhakaran, found themselves besieged in a small pocket of territory in Mullaithivu. Surrounded by the advancing Sri Lankan Army, the LTTE faced intense military pressure and dwindling resources. The final battle was a desperate struggle for survival, with both sides fiercely committed to their cause.

The Sri Lankan Army launched a massive offensive, employing heavy artillery, airstrikes, and ground troops to encircle and neutralize the LTTE stronghold. The battle was characterized by intense combat, with reports of heavy casualties and widespread destruction.

Despite the LTTE's long-standing reputation for fierce resistance, they were ultimately overwhelmed by the superior firepower and strategic advancements of the Sri Lankan military. On May 18, 2009, the Sri Lankan Army announced the death of Velupillai Prabhakaran, marking the end of the LTTE's armed struggle.

The final battle of LTTE vs Sri Lankan Army in Mullaithivu remains a deeply contentious and emotive chapter in Sri Lanka's history, with lingering questions about the human cost of the conflict and the pursuit of lasting peace and reconciliation.

title: ☸🎶༻All Is Unbound (අතමිදුනේ)༺❀🎵☸ 'Sabbē saṁkhārā aniccāti' (සබ්බේ සංඛාරා අනිච්චාති) - meaning ☸🎶☸
description:
🎧 For the most immersive experience, listen with headphones to catch the low, resonant solo cello and the decay of the felt piano."All Is Unbound" is an intimate, deeply raw acoustic exploration of letting go, detachment, and ultimate liberation. 

Perfect for fans of dark, introspective singer-songwriters and minimalist folk projects like Iron & Wine, Damien Rice, Gregory Alan Isakov, Bon Iver, and The White Buffalo.

📜 Lyrics:

All Is Unbound (අතමිදුනේ) ❦ Melancholic Minimalist Folk • Raw Baritone 
The meaning of the chant  'Sabbē saṁkhārā aniccāti' ☸ සබ්බේ සංඛාරා අනිච්චාති ගාථා අර්ථය 

༺  The Sight  ༻
Through the eye of wisdom, the stilled mind sees:
All volitional actions taken to chase the dear things
They can never truly satisfy the urge for worldly pleasures.
Not to my liking, unfulfilling; they never ease the mental pressure.
සංකාරයේ වැඩපිළිවෙලම 
අනිසි බව පැණසින්ම දැකගන්නේ  
අස්සාදයේ කැමැත්තක් ඉටු 
නොවන බව පැණසින්ම දැකගන්නේ 

༺  First Fruit  ༻
In suffering, the stream-enterers no longer stay bound,
To the deep level of wisdom they have finally found.
This very insight becomes the open path profound-
The absolute purification, to become truly Unbound.
සෝවාන් ඵලයෙහී තරමට  
මෙලෙස දුකෙහී නැහැ බැඳී ගන්නේ 
දුකෙන් අතමිදෙනා සවුන් හට 
විශුද්ධිය වෙත මග එයම වන්නේ 

༺  The Turning Tide  ༻
Entering the Noble Path, opening the mind's inner eye,
The stream-enterer begins to see through the worldly lie.
They catch the first glimpse of the shifting, bitter tide,
And turn away from paths where the blind illusions hide.
සිටින මුත් අනිසය හැඳිනගෙන 
සෝවාන් වූ අරිය උත්තමයන්  
ලෝක පරිහරණයේ ඇති දුක 
වෙහෙස තවමත් නොමැත දැක යහමින් 

༺  The Exhaustion of Samsara  ༻
Walking the Noble Path, sharpening the inner eye,
The once and never-returners see the world without disguise.
They feel the heavy exhaustion, the crushing agony, and sigh-
That always bleed from chasing what inevitably dies.
සකදගැමි අනගැමී උතුමන්
පසිඳලන්නේ පැණස මතු කරමින් 
ලෝක පරිහරණයේ ඇති දුක 
වෙහෙස හොඳටම ඇතිය දැකගනිමින් 

༺  Noble Step  ༻
In suffering, those Nobles no longer stay bound,
To the high level of wisdom they have finally found.
This very insight becomes the open path profound-
The absolute purification, to become truly Unbound.
සකදගැමි අනගැමී තරමට 
මෙලෙස දුකෙහී නැහැ බැඳී ගන්නේ 
දුකෙන් අතමිදෙනා සවුන් හට 
විශුද්ධිය වෙත මග එයම වන්නේ 

༺  The Empty Aggregates  ༻
Not only volitional actions, but all five aggregates do
The shell of form, the shifting feelings, and perceptions, too.
They fail so miserably to yield a single essence through,
Leaving only empty misery when stripped down to the view.
සංකාරයට විතරක් නොවෙයි 
පස් කඳෙහි හැම දේට පොදු වන්නේ 
රූපයද වේදනා ආදී  
සියළු දම් වල අසාරය දන්නේ 

༺  The Coreless World  ༻
When the eye awakens, and no core or substance can be found...
The turning world is cast away, no longer worth this hollow ground.
By letting go of all we clutch, the bound mind is finally free...
Liberated from the dark, to realize Nirvana's peace...
ගන්ට හරයක් නොමැති වන තැන 
පරිහරණයට වටින් නැති වන්නේ 
ලෝකයේ දම් අත්හැරී නොඇලී 
මිදී යයි නිවන දෙවමින්නේ 

༺  The Arahant  ༻
In suffering, those Arahants no longer stay bound,
To the ultimate wisdom they have finally found.
This very insight becomes the open path profound-
The absolute purification, to become truly Unbound.
අරිහතුන් ඵලයෙහී තරමට 
මෙලෙස දුකෙහී නැහැ බැඳී ගන්නේ 
දුකෙන් අතමිදෙනා සවුන් හට 
විශුද්ධිය වෙත මග එයම වන්නේ 

༺  The Sovereign Declaration  ༻
The one who is unbound and woke no longer desperately clings,
And in the absence of desire, the stilled mind finds its wings.
In that majestic state of peace, the final truth is found-
With absolute certainty, echoing: "All is Unbound!"
අතමිදෙන්නා නැහැ ඇලෙන්නේ 
ඇලෙන්නෙ නැති  නම් මිදීලා යන්නේ 
මිදී ගිය තැන මිදුණු උතුමන් 
මිදුනෙමියි කියලා දැනං ඉන්නේ 

All is Unbound...
අතමිදුනේ...

The chains are gone...
Nirvana...
නොඇලෙන්නේ...
මිදුනේ...නිබ්බානං...

‘‘සබ‍්බෙ සඞ‍්ඛාරා අනිච‍්චා’’ති, යදා පඤ‍්ඤාය පස‍්සති
අථ නිබ‍්බින‍්දති දුක‍්ඛෙ, එස මග‍්ගො විසුද‍්ධියා.
‘‘Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’’ti, yadā paññāya passati
atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.

පදිකයාට දිවි අහිමිවෙයි...සියල්ල CCTV කැමරාවේ 

පදිකයෙකුගේ දිවි අහිමිකර පලා ගිය වෑන් රථයක් පැය දෙකක් ඇතුළත රියදුරු සමඟ අත්අඩංගුවට ගැනීමට මාදම්පේ පොලීසියේ රථ වාහන අංශයේ නිලධාරීන් සමත්ව තිබේ.

ඊයේ (16) රාත්‍රී 9.20ට පමණ මාදම්පේ සේනානායක විදුහල ආසන්නයේ මේ අනතුර සිදුව තිබුණි. 

අනතුරින් මියගොස් ඇත්තේ වත්තේගම මඩොල්කැලේ පදිංචිව සිටි රාමසාමි මයිල්වානගම් නැමති අයෙකි.

අනතුර සිදුවූ වහාම එම ස්ථානයට පැමිණි මාදම්පේ පොලීසියේ රථ වාහන අංශයේ නිලධාරීන් CCTV පරීක්ෂා කර වෑන් රථයේ ලියාපදිංචි අංකය සොයා ගෙන හෙට්ටිපොළ ප්‍රදේශයේ සඟවා තිබියදී සොයා ගෙන ඇත.

රියදුරු ඉතාලියේ රැකියාවක නිරත ගල්මුරුව හෙලේනා වත්ත ප්‍රදේශයේ පදිංචිකරුවෙකි.

title: Aadarei: live with orchestra! 7th & 8th august 2026. musaeus college auditorium 💕
description:
August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. Late entry may be restricted during the performance. No outside food or beverages permitted. Recording and flash photography may be restricted.

title: The Wizard Liz Story Is Sparking A Bigger Conversation About Motherhood
description:
When news broke that Wizard Liz gave the father of her child custody, the internet immediately split into two camps.

Some called her selfish.
Some called her brave.
Others argued that if a father made the same decision, the reaction would be completely different.

But beneath the outrage, a much bigger conversation is unfolding.

Why are mothers expected to sacrifice everything for their children while fathers are often praised simply for showing up? What happens when a woman decides she no longer wants to fight for custody? Does that make her a bad mother, a realistic mother, or a woman refusing to participate in a system she believes is stacked against her?

And what happens when the parent who wanted custody discovers that raising a child alone is far more demanding than they imagined?

The Wizard Liz controversy has sparked a global debate about motherhood, fatherhood, custody, parental responsibility, and the double standards society places on women.

In today’s video, we’re discussing the facts, the public reaction, the growing number of women questioning traditional expectations surrounding motherhood, and the one person many people believe is being overlooked in this conversation:

The child.

Join the discussion below.

Do you think society judges mothers and fathers differently when it comes to custody and parenting?

description:
ලෝකයම කණපිට පෙරළන 2026 භයානකම සූර්යග්‍රහණය | මේ ලග්න 4ට දැඩි අනතුරු! අලුත් වැඩ පටන්ගන්නම එපා

2026 අගෝස්තු 12 සිදුවන ලෝකයම කණපිට පෙරළන මහා සූර්යග්‍රහණය ඔබේ ලග්නයට කෙසේ බලපායිද? කෝවිඩ් ව්‍යසනයටත් වඩා දරුණු කාලයක් ඉදිරියේදී එයිද යන්න මේ වීඩියෝවෙන් සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම පැහැදිලි කරයි.

මේ සූර්යග්‍රහණය ලංකාවට මෙන්ම මුළු ලෝකයටම (විශේෂයෙන් ඇමරිකාවට සහ යුරෝපයට) කරන බලපෑම, සිදුවිය හැකි දේශපාලන පෙරළි, ආර්ථික කඩාවැටීම් සහ ලග්න 12ටම සිදුවන සුබ අසුබ ඵල මෙහි අන්තර්ගතයි. විශේෂයෙන්ම මේෂ, වෘෂභ, මිථුන ආදී ලග්න හිමියන්ට ඉදිරි මාස කිහිපය තුළ ගන්නා තීරණ ගැන මෙහිදී දැඩි අනතුරු ඇඟවීම් සිදුකර ඇත. ඔබේ ලග්නයට හිමි පලාපල නිවැරදිව දැනගෙන ජීවිතයේ ඉදිරි තීරණ බුද්ධිමත්ව ගන්න.

මේ වගේ තවත් ජ්‍යෝතිෂ්‍යමය කරුණු සහ නිවැරදි පලාපල එසැණින් දැනගැනීමට අපගේ නාලිකාව Subscribe කරන්න. ඔබේ ලග්නය පහළින් Comment කරගෙන යන්න, ඒ වගේම මේ වටිනා වීඩියෝව ඔබේ යාළුවන්ටත් බලන්න Share කරන්න!

description:
✍ We explored the world-famous James Bond Island (Khao Phing Kan) in Phuket, Thailand — a cinematic paradise made iconic by the 007 movie "The Man with the Golden Gun." Surrounded by towering limestone cliffs and emerald-green waters, this was one of the most breathtaking places we've ever visited.

Our adventure didn’t stop there — we went kayaking through the magical caves and lagoons of Phang Nga Bay, a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Floating under limestone arches and between secret cliffs felt like stepping into another world. 

After soaking in the coastal beauty, we headed back to Andakira Hotel in Patong to relax and recharge. This cozy hotel gave us the perfect break after an action-packed day.

The next morning, we flew from Phuket back to Bangkok via domestic flight — smooth, quick, and convenient. But our journey wasn't over! We then took a private taxi van straight to Pattaya, one of Thailand’s most exciting coastal cities, known for its nightlife, beaches, and endless energy. 

This video captures every part of our journey — the beauty, the vibes, and the real experiences of traveling through Thailand.

MIssion in brief:

Abigail is worried about John Marston, who hasn’t returned in two days after going on scouting.
She asks Arthur and Javier to go look for him. Arthur doesn’t really want to, but Hosea convinces him to help.
Arthur and Javier ride out together. After a while, Javier sees a camp in the distance and speeds up.
Soon, they find John's horse, dead and badly attacked by animals. Javier fires his gun to signal John, and they hear John calling for help in the distance. They leave their horses behind and climb through snowy cliffs. Eventually, they find John—he’s hurt and covered in blood. Arthur and Javier help him back to the horses. As they return, three wolves attack, but Arthur kills them.

While riding down the mountain, more wolves appear. Javier speeds up and Arthur shoots the wolves again. After that, there are no more attacks. When they reach the camp, John is taken inside, and Abigail scolds him for getting hurt.

title: 💀⚕⚠️The Mortal Shell is driven down the highway of samsara⚠️ කුණු කය යනවා මහපාරේ💀⚕⚠️A Mortuary Chant
description:
⚠️ The Mortal Shell is driven down the highway of samsara’s lane. ⚠️Dive into a profound reflection on the true nature of the physical form. This mortuary chant for the flesh strips away the superficial illusions of beauty, health, and permanence. 

Blending evocative English verse with traditional Sinhala Buddhist concepts of Asubha Bhavana (meditation on the foulness of the body), this piece exposes what lies beneath the skin, hair, and nails.Listen, reflect, and break free from the desperate grasp of attachment. Witness the bitter cycle of samsara and the inevitable decay of this transient form."අනිච්චං දුක්කං සංසාරේ... කුණු කය යනවා මහ පාරේ..."

📜 Read the Lyrics / Mortuary Chant:

⚠️The Mortal Shell is driven down the highway of samsara’s lane⚠️
⚕⚰️💀💉🧠A Mortuary Chant for the Flesh)🧠💉💀⚰️⚕

Behind hair, fur, skin, nails, and teeth, hiding all kinds of filth,
කුණු වෙලා යන කය දරං හරි හැඩ කියාලයි හිතන්නේ
Bearing a decaying body, we think of it as beautifully built.
කෙස් ලොම් නිය දත් හංකඩෙන් කුණු විසි හතක් වහ ගන්නේ

Fashioned out of transient forms, in various shapes and hues,
කෙස් ලොම් නිය දත් හංකඩේ එක එක හැඩයට තියෙන්නේ  
We look upon this mortal shell and praise its empty views.
පාටට පේනා හැඩයට හරි ලස්සන කයක් කියන්නේ

Each moment it gathers corruption and pours the waste away,
මොහොතක් ගානේ කුණු අරං යළි  කුණුම එළියට දමන්නේ
Yet we wash the flesh in secret to keep the stench at bay.
එළියට ගඳ නොදැනෙන්නට එහි කුණු සෝදලා හරින්නේ

We constantly polish this outer veil to keep it looking fair,
හංකඩේ නිති ඔප දමං හැඩ කර ගන්නමයි හදන්නේ 
Yet a single scratch reveals the rot that lingers hidden there.
හංකඩේ හෙම හීරුණොත් කැත එළියට කැපිල පෙනෙන්නේ

No matter how safely we guard this form, it breaks beneath the breath,
කොහොම රැක්කත් ලෙඩ හැදී දිර දිරා ඇඳට වැටෙන්නේ  
Wasting away through sickness till it falls to sovereign death.
ටිකෙන් ටික අබලන් වෙලා එය මැරෙන තැනටම වැටෙන්නේ

Bearing this decaying frame, why crave another's clay?
මෙවන් වූ කුණු කය දරං තව කෙනෙකුගේ කය ලොබින්නේ
Is it truly worth our desperate grasp to own what fades away?
අයිති කරගෙන රස විඳින්නට වටිනව දැයි හිතන්නේ

See how this bitter cycle turns, through unfulfillment and pain,
අනිච්චං දුක්කං සංසාරේ 
This unholy frame is driven down the highway of samsara’s lane.

title: .༺🎵🎶༻The Great Release ༺🎵🎶༻.The meaning -'Dukkhappattāca niddukkhā🎵🎶༻ A Deep Baritone Rock Ballad ༺
description:
🎧 For the ultimate experience, listen with headphones to capture the deep sub-bass drone and sweeping cathedral reverb."Nirvana's Release" is a haunting, cinematic piece of dark alternative rock designed to evoke deep introspection and profound stillness. 

Moving at a heavy, meditative 50 BPM, the track strips away traditional percussion and Eastern instruments. It leaves behind only a raw, weathered baritone voice echoing over a minimalist landscape of clean electric guitar and a warm, atmospheric sub-bass drone.

The lyrics act as a powerful modern invocation, wishing liberation from suffering, fear, and sorrow for all mortal beings. The track builds from a breathy, intimate whisper into a massive, multi-layered soul-rock vocal belt. It creates a space where darkness meets absolute spiritual peace.

Perfect for fans of atmospheric post-rock, cinematic soundscapes, and deep, gravelly vocalists like Leonard Cohen, Nick Cave, or Mark Lanegan.

༺  The Sight  ༻
Through the eye of wisdom, the stilled mind sees:
All volitional actions taken to chase the dear things
They can never truly satisfy the urge for worldly pleasures.
Not to my liking, unfulfilling; they never ease the mental pressure.

༺  First Fruit  ༻
In suffering, the stream-enterers no longer stay bound,
To the deep level of wisdom they have finally found.
This very insight becomes the open path profound-
The absolute purification, to become truly Unbound.
සෝවාන් ඵලයෙහී තරමට

༺  The Turning Tide  ༻
Entering the Noble Path, opening the mind's inner eye,
The stream-enterer begins to see through the worldly lie.
They catch the first glimpse of the shifting, bitter tide,
And turn away from paths where the blind illusions hide.
සිටින මුත් අනිසය හැඳිනගෙන

༺  The Exhaustion of Samsara  ༻
Walking the Noble Path, sharpening the inner eye,
The once and never-returners see the world without disguise.
They feel the heavy exhaustion, the crushing agony, and sigh-
That always bleed from chasing what inevitably dies.

༺  Noble Step  ༻
In suffering, those Nobles no longer stay bound,
To the high level of wisdom they have finally found.
This very insight becomes the open path profound-
The absolute purification, to become truly Unbound.

༺  The Empty Aggregates  ༻
Not only volitional actions, but all five aggregates do
The shell of form, the shifting feelings, and perceptions, too.
They fail so miserably to yield a single essence through,
Leaving only empty misery when stripped down to the view.
සංකාරයට විතරක් නොවෙයි

༺  The Coreless World  ༻
When the eye awakens, and no core or substance can be found...
The turning world is cast away, no longer worth this hollow ground.
By letting go of all we clutch, the bound mind is finally free...
Liberated from the dark, to realize Nirvana's peace...

description:
✨ The Ascent from the Affixed Mind: An Electronic Journey Through the Spheres of Greed ('Lōbha'), Craving ('Taṇhā'), and Ultimate Liberation✨

✨ "The Ascent from the Affixed Mind" (🕸️🩸🦇A Cyber-Gothic Techno Liturgy🦇🩸🕸️) ✨

The Ascent from the Affixed Mind: An Electronic Journey Through the Spheres of Greed ('Lōbha'), Craving ('Taṇhā'), and Ultimate Liberation

Step into a moody, pulsing psychological exploration of the mind. This track is an alternative electronic production—blending the dark, hypnotic textures of ethereal darkwave and melodic synth-pop with crisp, upfront vocals and an arpeggiated electronic bassline.

If this atmospheric electronic reflection brings stillness or clarity to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with fellow seekers on the path. ☸️🌌

---
📖 LYRICS 

🌟 Verse 1: The Sucking In of the World
Drawing in and consuming the cosmic space,
Beings fall into greed and its dark embrace.
Through the eyes, tongue, and body, the nose, ear, and mind,
They consume all the world and are left tightly blind.

ලොව උරාබොන අර්ථයෙන් ගෙන
ලෝ අබ්බ ලෝභය වෙලා එන
ඇසෙන්, දිව, කය, නාසයෙන්, කන
හා මනෙන් ලෝකය උරා බොන
[Backing Vocals: ලෝභ] 

🌟 Verse 2: The Brahma Sphere of Attachment
No greed is first born for the objects outside,
No hunger for taste where the worldlings abide.
But attachment is born for the body alone,
This fathom-long frame in the Brahma world known.

රසට ගඳ ශබ්දයට වැනිවූ
දෙයට නැහැ ලෝභයක් ඇතිවූ
කයට මිස බඹයක් පමණ වූ
ලෝභ වුණු බඹ ලොවෙහි මතුවූ
[Backing Vocals: ලෝභ] 

🌟 Verse 3: The Celestial Deva Sphere
When mind-pleasing objects arrive from afar,
A secondary greed leaves a deep, hidden scar.
They claim them as "mine" as their treasures unfold,
This second state rules in the Deva world old.

මන වඩන දේ බාහිරෙන් එන
කයට දෙවනුව ඊට ලොබ වුණ
මගේ යයි ගෙන එකතු කරගෙන
දෙවන තැන සිත දෙව් ලොවෙහි වන
[Backing Vocals: ලෝභ] 

🌟 Verse 4: The Animal and Hellish Realms
As greed grows much deeper, its hunger takes hold,
They gather their fortunes through sins uncontrolled.
The mind degrades down to a third, lower state,
Where animal worlds and the dark hells await.

පවින් හෝ ගොඩ වඩාගන්නේ
තව තවත් ලෝභය වැඩෙන්නේ
සන් නමැති හිත වෙයි තෙවැන්නේ
එවන් සත තිරිසන් වෙමින්නේ
[Backing Vocals: ලෝභ] 

🌟 Verse 5: Vibhava Taṇhā (Craving for Non-Existence)
Believing that life has no future or dawn,
The root of deep greed is intensely reborn.
Accepting no sin and no realms of despair,
This craving for nothingness traps the mind there.

තෙවන තැන මතු භවක් නැත ගෙන
ලෝභ අකුසල මූල උපදින
පව්, අපායක් නොමැත පිළිගෙන
විභව තණ්හාවේ අයුරු වන
[Backing Vocals: විභව තණ්හා] 

🌟 Verse 6: Kāma Taṇhā (Sensual Craving)
Within the next mind frame where deep grasping lies,
On fleeting delights that all five senses prize.
Welcoming pleasures with heavy delight,
This shows how the sensual craving takes flight.

දෙවන තැන තෘෂ්ණාව තව වන
එක එකක් ප්‍රිය මනාපය ගෙන
අභිනන්දනය කරන ඇල්මෙන
කාම තණ්හා අයුරු පෙන්වන

🌟 Verse 7: Bhava Taṇhā (Craving for Existence)
Though well aware of Samsara and sin,
And knowing how low is the sensual realm within.
They harbor attachment for life to remain,
And this is how craving for birth holds its reign.

සසර, පව් ගැන හොඳින් දන්නේ
කාම ලෝකය නීච වන්නේ
එහෙත් දිවියට ලෝභ ගන්නේ
භව තණ්හාව මෙසේ වන්නේ
[Backing Vocals: භව තණ්හා]

🌟 Verse 8: The Stream-Enterer (Sōtāpanna)
By cutting the roots of the lower realm's greed,
The noble Stream-Enterers are fully decreed.
Delivered from animal rebirths and hell,
They end all woeful planes where the lost worldlings dwell.

ලෝභ අකුසල මූල සිඳිමින්
සෝවාන් වුනු අරිය උතුමන්
මිදී තිරිසන් බව අපායෙන්
දුගතියට යන ගමන අවසන්
[Backing Vocals: සෝතාපන්න]

🌟 Verse 9: The Non-Returner (Anāgāmī)
Shattering sensual-lust and breaking ill-will,
They conquer sensuous worlds that capture and kill.
These noble Non-Returners now rise from the night,
Transcending the Deva worlds into the light.

කාමරාගය පටිඝ බිඳිමින්
ඉක්ම යන්නේ කාම ලෝකෙන්
අනාගාමී අරිය උතුමන්
දෙවන තැන දෙව්ලොව ඉක්මවන්
[Backing Vocals: අනාගාමි]

🌟 Verse 10: The Worthy One (Arahant)
Though tracing a subtle conceit of the mind,
To that fathom-long body still slightly inclined.
By conquering the craving for birth to exist,

description:
✨ "The Triple Treasure" (Acoustic Devotional Hymn) ✨

Take a moment to pause, breathe, and immerse yourself in this deeply reverent, acoustic hymn of refuge. Crafted in a modern sacred/gospel-influenced style, this track pairs raw, soulful acoustic strings with an emotional vocal delivery to honor the timeless wisdom of the Triple Gem: the Buddha, the Dhamma, and the Sangha.

This English rendition captures the profound depth of traditional Pali stanzas, tracing the path from hearing the ultimate truth, holding it close to the heart, and actively walking the path to break the cycle of Samsara. 

If this music brought peace to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with someone who needs a moment of spiritual calm. 🙏🌱

📖 LYRICS 
The Triple Treasure: A Hymn of Sacred Refuge in the Buddha, Dhamma, and Sangha
The Triple Treasure (යෝ වදතං පවරෝ මනුජේසු)

යෝ වදතං පවරෝ මනුජේසු | Yo vadataṁ pavaro manujesu
Who stands supreme amidst the human race,
With words of noble truth and flawless grace?
Revered by all for wisdom clear and bright,
A shining beacon in the dark of night.

ජේෂ්ඨ කවුරුද මිනිසුන් අතරින

The Sakya Sage, the Blessed Holy One,
Whose long and arduous task is fully done.
The vast Perfections fulfilled through the years,
Conquering the cycle of taints, sorrows and fears.
භගවත පුරමිණ සැම කළයුතු වන

Guided by wisdom and relentless might,
He broke the bonds and stepped into the light.
He crossed the raging ocean to the shore,
Where waves of sorrow break and crash no more.
ප්‍රඥා බලයෙන විරියද සමගින

To that Sugata, now I go for grace!
He leads us safely to our ultimate place.
The True Guide who sets the captives free,
I take my refuge in His majesty.
සුදුසු තැනට ගෙන නිවනට පමුණන

It tears down raw desire and roots out grief,
Detaching worldly bonds to bring relief.
It cuts the chains that hold the heavy heart,
And tears the fabric of the trap apart.
රාග දුරුකරන සෝකද දුරලන
අනුකූලව ලොව බැඳීම දුරලන

They do not chase the fleeting, worldly prize,
Unshaken by the earth, completely wise.
කොටස් අටක් වුන අරියන් හට වන

උපසම්පදා වන්ට මග ඵලයෙන

title: Kelebokka | Kalabokka 360 Upper Division View Point | Kandy | Travel to Travel Sri lanka VLOG #25
description:
*Kallebokka 360 viewpoint (height: 1,175m)  The summit is located right on the border of Matale and Kandy districts and shares the same ridge that forms Hathale min-worlds end and Hunnasgiriya mountain. The said ridge extends to the north and joins with western massif of Knuckles.

On a clear day, visitors can observe Central Highlands, Kandy City, Sembuwatte lake and Knuckles Mountains.

A Camping site and 02 estate bungalows are available for visitors to stay but need to be booked early. There is a half-finished Hindu shrine at the center of the flat summit and a hut made using sticks to enjoy the vistas. It’s better to visit in the mornings to enjoy the unobstructed views for mist tend to cover the area in the afternoons.

description:
🎧 For the absolute best experience, listen with high-quality headphones or a dedicated sound system to fully feel the deep analog sub-bass frequencies and expansive cavernous reverb."All Is Unbound" is a raw, cold, and hypnotic sonic gateway into mindfulness, detachment, and ultimate stillness. Moving at an unhurried, meditative 60 BPM, this track strips away all traditional acoustic drums to create an intimate, machine-age minimal wave meditation.

The electronic landscape relies entirely on a deep, warm analog synthesizer drone, a slow hypnotic pulse, and sweeping vintage pads that drift through vast, spacey echoes. This sparse, non-intrusive backdrop places the absolute focus on a raw, weathered baritone voice. Delivering deep Dhamma insights close to the microphone, the vocals catch every breath and grain of gravel, building smoothly from a chilling whisper into a majestic, multi-layered electronic choir lament—declaring the absolute breaking of life's chains.

Perfect for fans of dark ambient electronica, minimal wave, introspective synthwave, and late-night darkwave playlists designed for deep reflection, meditation, and thinking.

Pierce through the suffering, past the cruel lure of taste...
Prevent its arising, before the mind is blindly crazed...
Realize the grand cessation, let the binding fetters fall,

title: How to Survive a Grenade Blast 😫
description:
If someone throws a grenade near you,
running upright could make you a bigger target.

When it explodes, fragments don’t just rise upward.
They blast outward at high speed,
spreading in all directions close to the ground.

In this video, learn the basic survival principle people are taught in high-risk zones.

✅ Distance matters — even a few meters can reduce impact
✅ Get low immediately — fragments travel horizontally
✅ Lie flat to reduce your body’s exposed surface
✅ Keep your mouth slightly open to help reduce pressure shock

The goal isn’t to outrun the explosion.
It’s to minimize what the fragments can hit.

Dropping flat reduces your profile.
Solid cover — like thick concrete — is even better if nearby.

Explosions are unpredictable.
But height and exposure increase danger.

In extreme situations,
instinct says run.
Training says get low and seek cover.

දළදා සමිඳුන් උදෙසා තේවා රාජකාරිය මල්වතු පාර්ශ්වයෙන්, අස්ගිරි පාර්ශ්වයට පැවරේ

ශ්‍රී දළදා සමිඳුන් උදෙසා දෛනිකව සිදු කෙරෙන සම්ප්‍රදායානුකූල තේවා රාජකාරී කටයුතු මල්වතු මහා විහාර පාර්ශ්වයෙන් අස්ගිරි මහා විහාර පාර්ශ්වය වෙත පැවරීම අද (30) දින චාරිත්‍රානුකූලව සිදු විය.

ශ්‍රී දළදා වහන්සේගේ පැවිදි භාරකාරත්වය මල්වතු සහ අස්ගිරි උභය මහා විහාරීය මහානායක ස්වාමින්ද්‍රයන් වහන්සේ දෙනම වෙත පැවරී පවතින අතර, වසරක් පාසා දෙපාර්ශ්වය අතර තේවා කටයුතු හුවමාරු වීම රජ දවස පටන් පැවත එන ගෞරවනීය චාරිත්‍රයකි.

සෑම වසරකම ඇසළ පුන් පොහෝ දිනට පසුදින පස්වරුවේ මෙම තේවා මාරුව සිදු කිරීම සම්ප්‍රදාය වේ. ඒ අනුව, මෙවර තේවා කටයුතු භාරගත් අස්ගිරි පාර්ශ්වය විසින් ලබන වසරේ ඇසළ පුන් පොහෝ දිනට පසුදින දහවල් දක්වා ශ්‍රී දළදා සමිඳුන්ගේ තේවා කටයුතුවල භාරකාරිත්වය දරනු ලබයි.

title: 🎵🎶☸ The highway of samsara (සංසාරේ මහපාරේ) 🎵🎶☸ -  An 80s darksynth ballad for reflection 🎵🎶☸
description:
The highway of samsara (සංසාරේ මහපාරේ) An 80s darksynth ballad for reflection 

"Trudging along the highway of Samsara with a false sense of worth."
A dark, retro-futuristic sonic exploration of breaking out of the cosmic cycle. Blending the heavy, driving analog basslines of 80s Darksynth with deep philosophical insights on the path from darkness to the light of the Buddha. 

This track serves as an atmospheric, late-night soundtrack for deep personal reflection. Look past the blinding dream of the world.

If this soundscape resonates with your journey, please consider subscribing, liking, and sharing.

---

📜 MASTER LYRICS FOR CONTEMPLATION:

What is happening to me? Where do my footsteps lead?
What will become of the dreams and aspirations I feed?
Samsara takes no responsibility, nor does it care,
Yet blindly I follow the crowd through the cold, empty air.
මොකක්ද මට වෙන්නේ
පැතුම කිමක් වන්නේ
නැහැ නොවැ වග වන්නේ
මමත් කඩේ යන්නේ

Ignorance-driven deeds drag us through the endless cycle of rebirth,
Trudging along the highway of Samsara with a false sense of worth.
For if you see this relentless road for what it truly is,
You might just find the quiet path to escape the black abyss.
අවිඳුවෙ සංකාරේ
තලමින් මහ පාරේ
ගෙන යයි සංසාරේ
දැක්කොත් නම් බේරේ

We originally came from brightness, from a pure and spiritual shore,
But the distance traveled into bleakness has left us bruised and sore.
Moving further and further away from our true, unblemished line,
We suffer heavily, lingering in the dark, wasting away our time.
ආ ලෝකය එලියයි
ආ දුර නම් අඳුරුයි
නිජ ගතියෙන් දුර යයි
අඳුරේ සිට ලතැවෙයි

Why do we pant and gasp for breath in a world that is completely hollow?
Depart from the shadows of the past; there is no need to follow.
Do not cling to what is essence-less, break from the heavy night,
Turn your face from the blinding dream, and walk toward the light!
මොකටද හති ලන්නේ
අඳුරෙන් නික්මෙන්නේ
සාරයි නොම ගන්නේ
ආ ලෝකෙට යන්නේ

I worship, gazing up with reverence, at the Gōtama Buddha's name,
Who showed the path to leave the dark and put out the raging flame.
Knowing what the offenses are, the old wrongdoings fade away,
The supreme ways of conduct are understood, guiding me day by day.
අඳුරෙන් ආලෝකෙට - යන්නට මග කිව්වේ
වඳිනෙමි පැදකුනු කොට -  ගෝතම බුදු නාමේ
දන්නේ ඇවැත කිමැයි - ඇවතුම් නොමවන්නේ
පැවතිය යුතු උත්තම - පැවතුම් දැන් දන්නේ

No matter what the world may say, this life is unfulfilling (Anicca),
An endless trap of empty gains that keeps the spirit willing.
But it can never be made whole, it can never be complete,
Short of the ultimate liberation, we only taste defeat.
මොන දේ කිව්වත් නෑ 
අනිසිය නිසි වන්නේ
නිවනෙන් මෙපිටට නෑ 
සැපයක් පවතින්නේ 

Free from the heavy chains of fear, free from the weight of sorrow,
The state of true unmoving bliss belongs to no tomorrow.
By ceasing to chase the hollow ghosts of futile, blind desire,
I will no longer burn my hand in Samsara’s scorching fire.
බිය සෝකය නැති
සුවඅත නිවනම වේ 
පුහු ඉච්චාවෙන් නැහැ

title: Wangedigala Hike & Camping with @ManiYaOfficial  | Breathtaking Views & Fun Moments! 🌄
description:
Wangedigala, situated in Kalupahana within the Badulla district of Sri Lanka's Uva province, is renowned as a favored hiking destination, particularly cherished by locals. It forms part of a rock peak continuum that includes Wangedi-kanda and Balatuduwa, eventually culminating in Gonmolliya, which stands approximately 2,034 meters tall, ranking as the 14th highest peak in the country. The moniker "Wangedigala" derives from Sinhala, where "Wangedi" translates to "pestle," aptly capturing the mountain's distinctive peak shape reminiscent of this kitchen tool. 

To reach Wangedigala from Belihuloya, travelers should embark on a journey approximately 14 kilometers along the Colombo – Batticaloa Highway, followed by an additional 3.2 kilometers along the Kalupahana – Ohiya Road. This route guides adventurers to the doorstep of Wangedigala, providing convenient access to embark on their hiking expedition or camping escapade amidst the captivating landscapes of this renowned destination.

The trek to Wangedigala offers adventurers a diverse landscape, leading them through pine forests, verdant grasslands, and cascading waterfalls, culminating in a breathtaking panoramic vista from the summit. Esteemed by locals, this hike demands considerable stamina, typically spanning 3 to 4 hours for the average hiker. Moreover, Wangedigala's cool climate and awe-inspiring views make it a sought-after camping spot, enticing outdoor enthusiasts to bask in its natural splendor.

Traversing the forested paths of Wangedigala rewards hikers with breathtaking vistas of the surrounding landscape, showcasing notable landmarks such as the majestic Bambarakanda Falls and the enchanting Lanka Ella Falls. However, navigating these trails entails ascending steep mountain slopes cloaked in a carpet of pine needles. Consequently, hikers must exercise added caution, particularly as these slopes can become slippery when dry, necessitating additional safety measures to ensure a secure and enjoyable trekking experience.

සදහම් ජලයෙන් සෝදා ගරමින් 
සම්මා සමවත් සිරි මිණි කැට සොයමින්

Bringing forth the light where still meditations shine,
Sacred rays of shimmering gems illuminate the mind.
සමවත් ආලෝකය මතුකෙරෙමින් 
දිලෙනාවූ සිරි මිණි එළියේ කිරණින් 

Beholding all the power that the Triple Gem imparts,
Through changing tides of rain or shine, peace fills their hearts.
මහතුණුරුවනේ ගුණබල දකිමින් 
අට ලෝ දම කම්පාවෙන් සිත මුදමින්

Growing safe beneath the shade of seven suns’ warm heat,
Like tender rays of rising suns, their inner peace they meet.
සත් ඉර අව්වේ සෙවණේ වැඩෙමින් 
දලු ලා එන සමවත් ලා හිරු එළියන් 
As if shielded by pearl-umbrellas, screens, and carpets soft,
May Protection wrap them all around, below, and up aloft.
මුතුකුඩ පාවඩ වටතිර ලද මෙන් 
උඩ යට වට සැම රැකවරණය ලැබගන්

Bearing six gates hidden beneath a dark, ignorant blind,
The rays of the Dhamma clear the clouds within the waking mind.
සය අඳ වී ආ අවිඳුවෙ අඳුරෙන් 
කඩතුරාව පහවී යයි දම් කිරණින් 
Cultivating pure insight with wisdom’s radiant gleam,
The six sense-gates are purified in Dhamma's sacred stream.
විදු නැණ එළියෙන් වඩනා විදසුන් 
වන්නට හය එළිකරගත් සීහෙළයන්

Once bound to worldly pleasures, in struggles long and deep,
They see the truth as it is, renouncing what they reap.
ගැබ්කරගත් සත ලොව පොර බඳිමින් 
තතු පරිදිම දැක අතමිදෙනා ලෝකෙන්
May the Triple Gem's great virtues be awakened in every mind,
Burning down ignorance and conceit, as ashes scatter and unbind.
මානය ඛය වී යන්නට අලු මෙන් 
ගැබ්වේවා සතසිත සූවිසි ගුණයන් 

Dwelling deep in sanctuaries of meditative bliss,

May the raging fires of Samsāra fully cool and cease,

May great healing powers soothe all hearts and set them free.

title: 📿No Rescue or Bail📿කැපත් නැතිය, සැපත් නැතිය, ඇපත් නැතිය ⁂ Cinematic Dark Fugitive Psych Folk Anthem❧
description:
✨ "No Rescue or Bail" (Cinematic Dark Fugitive Psych-Folk Anthem) ✨

Brace yourself for a gripping, high-stakes acoustic pursuit through the deep architecture of the mind. This track is an alternative cinematic production—blending the dark, tense textures of psych-folk with an urgent, galloping acoustic march, a thumping low frame-drum pulse that mimics a racing heartbeat, and a raw, panicking upfront male vocal delivery.

The lyrics approach the foundational Three Marks of Existence (Tilakkhana) through a vivid, intense metaphor: a breathless fugitive running out of safehouses, frantically escaping the traps of the worldly wheel. It details how the world we once embraced with lust and delight ultimately chases us down with endless cascades of deep woe. Realizing that the five physical senses are a toxic trap, that no lasting comfort remains (Dukkha), and that there is absolutely no permanent essence or refuge to be gained in hindsight (Anatta), the mind is forced into ultimate surrender. By shedding the impurities of the heart and guarding each sense gate, the track builds to a soaring, defiant climax—putting a final full stop to the illusions of Samsara.

If this raw, high-intensity acoustic reflection brings a profound sense of clarity or stillness to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with fellow seekers on the path. ☸️🏃‍♂️🛡️🌲

---
📖 LYRICS 📖

No Rescue or Bail: A Psych-Folk Edition 
No Rescue or Bail (කැපත් නැතිය, සැපත් නැතිය, ඇපත් නැතිය)

The world we embraced with our lust and delight,
Now chases us down through the dark of the night.
It hounds us with fury and will not let go,
Inflicting its endless cascades of deep woe.
ශෝක් කියාලා රතියෙන් අල්ලගත්තු ලෝකේ
පස්සෙන් එලවා විත් දෙයි හෝසෙට දුක ශෝකේ

Completely exhausted and breathless we run,
Chasing the phantoms beneath the cold sun.
Unmindful and blind on this treacherous track,
We find only grief on the road we walk back.
හුස්ම ගන්න බෑ හොඳටම හති දුවලා මේකේ
සිහිය පතක් නැතුව දුවල ලැබුණේ දුක සෝකේ

The pleasures of senses are toxic to chase,
They bring but a mountain of pain to this space.
No lasting comfort or substance will remain,
From everything heavy we strive to maintain.
අල්ලගන්න කැපත් නැතිය දුක් ගොඩකිය ලෝකේ
අල්ලං ගත් සැපක් නැතිය ඉතිරි වෙලා මේකේ

Enduring this pain might be worth how we tried,
If there were an essence to gain in hindsight. 
But looking much closer, no rescue is found—
Like grabbing a tiger's tail, no escape around.
දුක් වින්දත් කමක් නැතිය හරය වෙතොත් මේකේ
බලං යද්දි ඇපත් නැතිය කොටි වලිගෙකි ලෝකේ

Lost without awareness, we drank the dark wine,
Consuming ourselves in a worldly design.
No shelter (anicca), no comfort (dukka), no rescue or bail (anatta)—
within this dark world where illusions prevail.
සාරයි ගත්තේ ගොංකම නිසා මිසක් මේකේ 
කැපත් නැතිය (අනිච්ච),  සැපත් නැතිය (දුක්ක), ඇපත් නැතිය (අනත්ත),  චීකේ

Just as the Great Buddha once taught of the scheme,
We see that this life is an empty, false dream.
By taming the mind till the craving decays,
The fettering view fades away from our gaze.
බුදුන් කිව්ව පරිදි අසාරය දැකගෙන මේකේ
සිත දමනය කරොත් ලොවට හිතැති දිට්ටි වියැකේ

The grit and the filth that were trapped in the mind,
Are shed one by one as they leave us behind.
With mindful presence guarding each sense gate,
I turn from the paths that lead down to dark fate.
හිතේ තියෙන කුණු ටික ටික හැලිලා ගිහිං අහකේ
සිහිය පතක් ඇතිව වෙසෙමි ඉන් හැම පව් වැළකේ

Erasing defilements that kept me bound tight,
I break from this world and step into the light.
Refusing to wander or drift in the dark,
I place a full stop on this sorrowful arc.
සියලුම කුණු ගති දුරුවී ඉන්නෙ නැතුව ලෝකේ

title: SLTMobitel AI Awards Registration
description:
நீங்கள் AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்ட ஒரு தீர்வை உருவாக்கியிருக்கின்றீர்களா, மேம்படுத்தியிருக்கின்றீர்களா அல்லது வெற்றிகரமாக நடைமுறைப்படுத்தியிருக்கின்றீர்களா?
அப்படியென்றால், அங்கீகாரம் பெறுவதற்கான உங்கள் வாய்ப்பு இதுவே.
தேசிய AI விருதுகள் 2026, உண்மையான புத்தாக்கம் மற்றும் தாக்கத்தின் மூலம் இலங்கையின் AI புரட்சியை முன்னெடுத்துச் செல்லும் தனிநபர்கள், குழுக்கள் மற்றும் நிறுவனங்களை கௌரவிக்கின்றது.
உங்கள் AI முயற்சி தொழில்துறைகளில் மாற்றத்தை உருவாக்குகின்றதா?
நிஜ வாழ்வின் சவால்களுக்கு தீர்வுகளை வழங்குகின்றதா?
அல்லது செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவின் எல்லைகளை விரிவுபடுத்துகின்றதா?
அப்படியென்றால், இன்றே உங்கள் விண்ணப்பத்தை சமர்ப்பியுங்கள்.|

title: 🏛 The Architecture of Causality (හේතුඵල වාදය)📜(An immersive, guided meditation, spoken-word journey)
description:
🏛 The Architecture of Causality (හේතුඵල වාදය) 📜 
(An immersive, cinematic guided meditation and spoken-word journey into the core of Theravada Buddhist philosophy.)

"Whatever phenomena arise from a cause, The Great Teacher has explained those causes..." | "යම් ධර්මයක් හේතුන් නිසා සම්භවය වෙත්ද, එසේ පහළව එන්ට හේතුන් පහදනා සමිඳ"

✍ Tracing the Causal Chain ⛓ from Ignorance to Ultimate Liberation 🎤

An immersive, cinematic guided meditation and spoken-word journey into the core of Theravada Buddhist philosophy. This track systematically breaks down the universal law of cause and effect (Hetu-Phala), the nature of existence, and the ultimate path to liberation. 

Weaving a pristine, deep male vocal narrative with a dark ambient, Matrix-inspired electronic soundscape, this track guides you through the profound structural mechanics of the mind and reality.

---
📜 THE 11-VERSE ARCHITECTURE:

1. The Core Summary (The Ye Dhammā Stanza / යේ ධම්මා හේතුප්පභවා)
The historic summary of causality originally spoken by Arhat Assaji, establishing that all things rise and fall through conditions.

2. The Definition of Dhamma (ධර්මයේ අර්ථය)
Understanding Dhamma as that which bears its own nature, dividing reality into the worldly phenomena and the Buddha-Dhamma.

3. The World of the Aggregates (පංචස්කන්ධ ලෝකය)
Exposing how the "world" we cling to is constructed entirely across time and space by Form, Sensation, Perception, Mental Formations, and Consciousness.

4. The Insight of the Noble Ones (පටිච්චසමුප්පාද දර්ශනය)
Realizing that seeing the Law of Dependent Origination is seeing the Dhamma, and seeing the Dhamma is seeing the Buddha.

5. The Realization of the Path (මාර්ගාවබෝධය)
How the Noble Disciple (Ariya Savaka) systematically dismantles suffering by actively withholding its fuel and cultivating the Unfettered State (Sammā).

6. The Unmeritorious Cycle / Apuñña (අපුණ්‍ය අභිසංස්කාර)
Tracing the dark, unwholesome causal chain driven by ignorance and craving, inevitably terminating in decay and death.

7. The Meritorious Cycle / Puñña (පුණ්‍ය අභිසංස්කාර)
The profound realization that even meritorious actions, inspired clarity (Prasāda), and crowning convictions (Adhimokkha) remain bound to the universal destiny of decay and death.

8. Gratification and Danger / Assāda & Ādīnava (ආස්සාද සහ ආදීනව)
Peeling back the illusion of a solid "being." Witnessing the temporary sweetness of the world give way to its inherent, destructive dangers.

9. Overcoming False-Knowledge / Avijjā (අවිද්‍යාව දුරුකිරීම)
Defining true ignorance as the lack of knowing the arising and ceasing of the aggregates, and shifting into the vision of Inappropriateness (Anicca).

10. Relinquishing Delusion (මුලාවෙන් මිදීම)
Dispelling deluded, compromising formations by completely aligning the mind with the law of cause and effect.

11. The Eye of Wisdom & The Noble Friend (විද්‍යු ඇස සහ කල්‍යාණ මිත්‍රයා)
Culminating the journey by honoring the Kalyāṇa-mitta who sparks the Eye of Wisdom, and the Supreme Buddha who unearths this eternal truth for all.


🌿 Practice Notes:
This track is designed for deep listening, reflection, and Vipassana (insight) mindfulness practice. Allow the spacious gaps and atmospheric synth pads to clear your mind as you trace the causal loops of your own awareness.

If this recitation brought clarity to your practice, please like, subscribe, and share this truth with fellow noble friends. 

May all beings be well, comfortable, and peaceful. May you attain the ultimate peace of Nibbana.

title: The Birthrate Meltdown Has Begun
description:
Around the world, birth rates are continuing to fall, and the conversation is becoming impossible to ignore. More men are publicly discussing declining fertility, shrinking populations, and what these trends could mean for the future.

In this episode, we examine why this discussion is gaining momentum, what people are saying online, and why opinions are so deeply divided. While governments, economists, commentators, and everyday people debate the consequences of population decline, many women argue that the reasons behind their decisions have been discussed for years.

This isn’t a conversation about fear. It’s a conversation about changing priorities, shifting expectations, economics, relationships, and the future of family life.

What happens when one side believes this crisis appeared out of nowhere while the other believes the warning signs have been visible all along?

❌ Eat = කනවා

❌ Work = වැඩ කරනවා

Learning like this is not enough.

Instead...

✅ Learn every verb with many examples.

When you see and hear the same verb in different sentences, your brain naturally understands how native speakers use it.

That is exactly why this lesson includes 300 simple examples.

The more examples you learn, the easier it becomes to:

🗣️ Speak naturally
👂 Understand English faster
🧠 Remember vocabulary for a long time
💬 Build your own English sentences confidently

description:
LINDT HOME OF CHOCOLATE MUSEUM IN ZURICH SWITZERLAND |  ලෝකේ ලොකුම චොක්ලට් කම්හල යමු  🇨🇭 

Lindt Chocolate Museum Tour in Zurich Switzerland. On the tour you discover the history of Swiss Chocolate through interactive exhibits. The best part is the free unlimited chocolate tasting of all the Lindt Chocolate flavours.
As soon as you enter you are greeted with a large Chocolate Fountain as well as the worlds largest Lindt Chocolate Shop and a Chocolate Cafe.
The Lindt Chocolate Factory tour or Lindt Home of Chocolate Museum has three sections where you can try out their chocolate for free, the first is an area with chocolate fountains offering milk chocolate, white chocolate and dark chocolate. The second is automated dispensers that shoot pieces of chocolate into your hands. And finally a room full of Lindt Chocolate balls in many flavours that you can help yourself to.
We really did eat so much free Chocolate at the Lindt Home of Chocolate we started to feel sick.
I would recommend this tour to anyone in Zurich, Switzerland and it was great value for money as well. At the time of our visit it was 15CHF for Adults and 10CHF for Children.

මෙරට දකුණු කොරියානු තානාපතිනි මියන් ලී සහ අධිකරණ සහ ජාතික ඒකාබද්ධතා අමාත්‍ය නීතිඥ හර්ෂණ නානායක්කාර මහතා අතර හමුවක් අද (10) අධිකරණ අමාත්‍යාංශයේදී පවත්වා තිබේ. 

එහිදී දෙරට අතර රාජතාන්ත්‍රික සබඳතා ශක්තිමත් කිරීම පිළිබඳව සහ වර්මානයේ මෙරට පවතින ආර්ථික, දේශපාලනික සහ සාමාජීය තත්වය පිළිබඳව මෙන්ම ද්විපාර්ශ්වික වශයෙන් වැදගත් කරුණු බොහොමයක් පිළිබඳව සාකච්ඡා කර ඇත.

අධිකරණ සහ ජාතික ඒකාබද්ධතා අමාත්‍යංශයේ අතිරේක ලේකම් (නීති) පියුමන්ති පිරිස් මහත්මිය සහ ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ දකුණු කොරියානු තානාපති කාර්යාලයේ උසස් නිලධාරියකු මෙම අවස්ථාවට සහභාගී විය.

title: Nothing Phone 1 CMF in Sri Lanka
description:
🧩 Why CMF Phone 1 exists Budget-conscious sub‑brand: CMF by Nothing launched in 2023 to make design-focused devices available at more accessible prices than mainline Nothing products . Modular, fun aesthetic: The Phone 1’s back panel is easily removable to swap colors or add accessories—like lanyards, card holders, kickstands—with just a screwdriver and magnets The Verge +1 The Sun +1 . Affordable specs with style: It packs a 6.7" OLED, a 5,000 mAh battery, a MediaTek Dimensity chipset, and Nothing OS, all for around (~USD 199 at launch) Reddit +5 The Verge +5 WIRED +5 . 🎯 Position: Why choose it? You want a budget-friendly yet design-forward phone. You enjoy modularity and customization—personalizing hardware, not just software. You're okay skipping premium perks like NFC or full waterproofing in exchange for standout design and fun extras. ⚠️ Some trade-offs + feedback Limited features: No NFC, only splash-resistant, and carrier support (especially in the US) can be spotty support.nothing.tech The Sun The Verge . Touchscreen quirks: Some users have reported inconsistent touch response or accidental taps—likely a software/filter calibration issue Nothing Community +1 Reddit +1 . Support and accessories: Accessories cost extra and might not be widely available, especially outside Europe androidcentral.com . ✅ So why "Nothing Phone 1 CMF"? It’s simply Nothing's way of signaling: “This is our CMF sub‑brand phone — the Phone 1 model.” It puts design, customization, and affordability front and center — without hiding behind the main Nothing branding or pricing structure. TL;DR: CMF = Color – Material – Finish, and the Phone 1 is a stand‑alone device from that design‑focused, budget‑friendly sub‑brand. If you're drawn to modular design, bold styling, and solid features under $200–250, it's a unique and fun pick — but be aware of its compromises.

title: Even in Death, Elephants Love Their Babies 🥰
description:
When an elephant becomes very old and reaches the end of its life, something heartbreaking can happen.

Sometimes the elephant remains standing quietly, almost as if nothing is wrong. From a distance, it can look like the animal is simply resting.

But many wildlife observers have noticed something touching in these final moments.

Older elephants often try to stay calm and peaceful around the herd. They don’t panic or make loud distress calls. Instead, they remain still, as if everything is normal.

Some people believe this behavior helps the younger elephants stay calm, making the moment feel less frightening for the herd.

Elephants are known for their deep social bonds. They care for injured members, protect their calves, and often stay close to one another throughout life.

Even without words, their actions show something powerful — loyalty, memory, and quiet care for their family.

description:
✍  Walking through China Town in Bangkok, Thailand at night felt like stepping into another world. The streets were alive with neon lights, the sound of sizzling woks, and the endless aroma of food cooking on every corner. Among the famous noodles, dumplings, and sweets, we found something very different – the kind of food that makes you stop and think twice before taking a bite.

This time, we decided to be brave and try some of the most unusual street food Thailand has to offer  fried cockroaches, crunchy worms, and even Bullseye (fertilized egg). At first, it was a little scary holding them in our hands, but the atmosphere, the energy of the crowd, and the encouragement from the street vendors gave us the courage to go for it.

The first bite was a mix of shock and surprise  the worms were crispy and salty, the cockroach had a strong crunch, and the Bullseye was unlike anything we’ve ever tasted before. It wasn’t just about eating; it was about experiencing a piece of Thai culture that many travelers never forget.

title: August 7th & 8th | Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei” | Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com
description:
August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. Late entry may be restricted during the performance. No outside food or beverages permitted. Recording and flash photography may be restricted.

at Musaeus College Auditorium

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.

title: I Collected All IPhones From 1 to 18
description:
From the very first iPhone launched in 2007 to the brand new iPhone 18, I now tested every single iPhone ever made. In this video, I'm showing you the entire collection for the first time.

I spent a long time hunting down every iPhone model, including the rare and discontinued ones that are almost impossible to find in India today. You'll see how the design, camera, screen, and price changed year after year, from the tiny original iPhone all the way to the latest iPhone 18. I also turn on the old models to see if they still work, compare their speed to the newest iPhone, and react to how much technology has changed in less than 20 years.
The biggest surprises in this video include which old iPhone still performs shockingly well, how much money the entire collection actually costs today, and which iPhone model was the hardest one to track down. By the end, you'll see the complete story of the iPhone, from the very beginning to now, all in one place.

The hike to Hawagala is quite a difficult one but the view at the summit is so amazing that it is worth the climb. Locals and foreigners are both attracted to the surrounding paddy fields, forest, mountain and the beautiful waterfall in this area and is a reason for it to become a tourist hot spot in the Sabaragamuwa province.
From Belihuloya travel a total of approximately 4.2 km along the Colombo – Batticaloa Highway and Ihala Galagama Road to reach Hawagala.

description:
📝 Unfettering the View: 🏷️The Journey from Delusion to Nibbana

Experience a unique musical journey through the core teachings of Theravada Buddhism. Written as a modern English song in the style of 90s alternative acoustic rock, "Unfettering the View" tracks the absolute transformation of the human mind—advancing from the dense blindness of ignorance to the pristine, unconditioned peace of Nibbana.

Inspired by deep Pali and Sinhala Dhamma verses, the song uses vivid metaphors to map out the traps of sensory gratification, the illusion of a lasting existence, the critical pivot of planting merits, and the ultimate uprooting of the cycle of rebirth by an Arahant.

Behind a sweet smile, the rot lives inside.
