description:
✨ "The Unshaken Roots" (A Vintage 1960s Duet on Araññagathovā) ✨

Step into a timeless, cinematic sanctuary of sound. This track is an alternative vintage production—crafted in the precise style of 1960s baroque pop and spaghetti-western psych-folk. It pairs a low, gritty male baritone narration (delivering the English context) with a sultry, breathy female vocal response (delivering the original Sinhalese verses) over a slow guitar walk and sweeping orchestral strings.

The lyrics mirror the foundational meditation instructions of the Anapanasati Sutta. It traces the mind's retreat from the internal warfare of worldly desire into the quietude of a forest monastery (Arañña), an empty house (Suññāgāra), or the foot of a tree (Rukkhamūla). Through the metaphor of deep, hidden roots standing unmoved by the shifting worldly winds, the song charts the silent development of deep concentration (Samādhi) leading to ultimate liberation (Sammā Vimutti).

If this nostalgic, soulful reflection brings peace to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with fellow travelers on the path. ☸️🌲🎻


🌟 Verse 1: The Internal Wilderness
Living bound to desire, in the wild world we roam,
Unable to face the deep quiet at home.
Beings feast on the senses like nectar divine,
While the sanctuary inside never blossoms to shine.
රාගය හා දිවි ගෙව්වේ - එකලා වෙන්නට නොහැකිව වේ 
පංච කාම රා අම වේ - ආරාමය හද නොම මතුවේ  

🌟 Verse 2: The Echo of War
When worldly attachments are broken and denied,
Resentment and conflict awaken inside.
A massive war rages, a storm in the mind,
Where the roars of the battle leave stillness behind.
ලෝ දම් කෙරෙහිය ඇලුනේ - නොලැබෙන තැන ගැටීම සිදුවේ 
මහ සටනක් සිත මතුවේ - රණ ගොස මිස අරණක් නොම වේ

🌟 Verse 3: The Cooling of Resentment
Subduing that inner and turbulent war,
We close up the senses and lock every door.
Emptied of craving, the burning will cease,
As the mind cools down to a resentment-free peace.
- Araññagathovā -
දමනය කොට සිත රණ ඒ - පස්කම් වෙත ඉඳුරන් වැසුවේ 
රාගය නැති හිත නිව්නේ - රණ නැති සන්සුන් සමනය වේ 

🌟 Verse 4: The Empty House (Suññāgāra)
The mind enters the space of a house wide and clear,
As applied and sustained thoughts both fast disappear.
Deep rapture and bliss saturate form and mind,
Wrapped in solid equanimity, pure and refined.
- Suññāgāragathovā -
ශුණ්‍යාගාරෙක සිත වේ - විතක්ක විචාරයන් දුරුවේ 
ප්‍රීතිය සුඛ ගත සිත වේ - උපේක්‍ෂාව තර වී විසුවේ 

🌟 Verse 5: Unshaken Roots (Rukkhamūla)
While leaves and broad branches sway back in the cold,
In winds from four quarters, uncontrolled.
The deep roots below bear the weight of the trunk,
Unmoved by the storm where the worldlings have sunk.
- Rukkhamūlagathovā -
හතර වටින් එන සුලඟේ - එහෙ මෙහෙ වැනෙනා කොළ අතු වේ 
බරත් දරන් කඳ දැරු ඒ - කිසි කම්පා නැති රුක් මුල් වේ 
හතර වටින් එන සුලඟේ - එහෙ මෙහෙ වැනෙනා කොළ අතු වේ 
බරත් දරන් කඳ දැරු ඒ - කිසි කම්පා නැති රුක් මුල් වේ 

🌟 Verse 6: Facing Worldly Winds
Driven by currents, the worldly are shaken,
Hurling hostility at those who awaken.
But the Noble One stands without anger or fear,
Like deep forest roots when the tempest draws near.
- Rukkhamūlagathovā -
කම්පිත අට ලෝ දහමේ - ලෝ සතගේ අවැඩත් ලැබුවේ  
උරණ නොවී ලෝ දහමේ - අකම්පිතව වන රුක් මුල් වේ 

🌟 Verse 7: Unfooled by Fleeting Gratification
For lifetimes across the samsaric domain,
Beings have chased after pleasure and pain.
Unfooled by the sweetness of passing delight,
The Sage stands unmoving like roots in the night.
- Rukkhamūlagathovā -
සසරක් සත රිය කෙරුවේ - කම් ආසාවන් පසුපස වේ 
මුලා නොවී අස්සාදේ - නොසෙලී ඉන්නා රුක් මුල් වේ 

🌟 Verse 8: Hidden Virtue
For lifetimes across the samsaric vast space,
Beings have strived for a proud, fleeting place.
Unseen by the crowd, deep hidden from sight,
The roots spread in secret, away from the light.
- Rukkhamūlagathovā -
සසරක් සත වෙර දැරුවේ - මගෙ මහිමය පෙන්වන්නට වේ 
කාටත් නොපෙනී පොළොවේ - ගැඹුරට විහිදුණු රුක් මුල් වේ 

🌟 Verse 9: The Emergence of Samādhi
Drawing in water and nourishing clay,
Driving growth in secret day by day.
Unshaken, the path of the Noble takes form,
Till the massive trunk of Samādhi breaks through the storm.
- Rukkhamūlagathovā -
පොහොරද දිය ඇද බෙදුවේ - නොපෙනී සිට කඳ අතු වැඩුවේ
අකම්පිතව මග වැඩුවේ - සමාධි කඳ පැන නැග මතුවේ  

🌟 Verse 10: Ultimate Liberation (Sammā Vimutti)
Absorbed in the noble, deep Jhāna of peace,
Fulfilling unfettering concentration's release.
As the eight Noble factors reach hype at last,
Unfettered wisdom and freedom are cast.
- Araññagathovā - - Suññāgāragathovā - - Rukkhamūlagathovā -

description:
✍  TIGER PARK IN PATTAYA | OPEN DAILY : 9AM - 6PM
We had the incredible opportunity to visit Tiger Park in Pattaya, Thailand, and experience something truly once-in-a-lifetime, touching, petting, and taking close-up photos with giant tigers! Tiger Park is a privately owned company that has been dedicated to raising and caring for tigers for over 20 years. With 3 branches and over 300 tigers under their care, they work tirelessly to ensure that every tiger receives round-the-clock attention, love, and support. Their mission is not only to maintain the health and happiness of these majestic animals but also to continually improve their quality of life.
During our visit, we learned how the staff and caretakers work closely with each tiger, ensuring they grow up in a safe, loving, and well-monitored environment. It was amazing to see the gentle side of these powerful creatures and to feel the connection you can have when treated with respect and care.

title: නාය ගිය ශ්‍රී පාදයට අහසින් ගියා ☸️  ✈️  TRIP PISSO FLEW OVER ADAM’S PEAK !
description:
✍ Experience the Sacred Peak from the Clouds! 

We took to the skies for the ultimate tour of Adam’s Peak (Sri Pada | श्री पाद ) with "TRIP ME"! Seeing this sacred mountain from a bird’s-eye view was a first for us, and it was absolutely breathtaking.
📍 Journey Highlights:
Take-off: We started our journey at Ratmalana Airport, Sri Lanka’s very first international airport, at 8:30 AM.
The Flight: It only took about 20 minutes to reach the mountain range.
The Views: We flew through the clouds and witnessed the stunning Gartmore Falls and several other waterfalls cascading directly into the Maussakelle Reservoir—a truly rare sight!
The Worship: The pilot did two full rounds around the peak, allowing us to worship Sri Padaya from above and see the summit from a perspective few ever get to see.
The Return: On our way back, we enjoyed beautiful coastal views passing over Panadura Beach and the iconic Kalutara Bodhiya.
If you’re looking for a way to see the "Sacred Footprint" without the 5,000-step climb, this is it! It was an amazing experience we will never forget.

Contact "Trip Me" : https://www.facebook.com/tripme.sl
💰 Cost: LKR 55,000 per person

පොලීසිය පැවසුවේ, පානදුර වලාන දූෂන මර්දන ප්‍රහාරක ඒකකයට අනුයුත්තව සේවය කළ පොලිස් කොස්තාපල්වරයෙක් මෙලෙස මියගොස් ඇති බවය.

වෙඩි වැදීමෙන් බරපතළ තුවාල ලැබූ පොලිස් කොස්තාපල්වරයා පානදුර මුලික රෝහලට ඇතුළත් කිරීමෙන් අනතුරුව මියගොස් ඇති බව සඳහන්ය.

මියගොස් ඇත්තේ 28 හැවිරිදි පේරාදෙණිය ප්‍රදේශයේ පදිංචි පුද්ගලයෙකු බව පොලීසිය පැවසුවේය.

title: Women Aren't Avoiding Broke Men...They're Avoiding Risk
description:
For generations, women were told that men are providers. Society built entire relationship expectations around the belief that a husband would be able to support a family, offer stability, and help protect the household from economic hardship.

But what happens when that expectation collides with modern reality?

Today, many women are being criticized for refusing to date or marry men who are not financially secure. The conversation is often reduced to accusations of “gold digging,” materialism, or unrealistic standards. Yet beneath the surface lies a much larger discussion about risk, responsibility, unpaid labor, childcare, financial dependence, and the long-term consequences of relationship decisions.

In this video, we explore why financial stability has become such a major concern for women, how economic realities have changed over time, and why many women view financial insecurity as more than just an income issue. We also examine the growing tension between traditional provider expectations and the realities of modern economies where many people struggle to support themselves, let alone a family.

This is not simply a conversation about money.

It’s a conversation about labor, sacrifice, risk, survival, and the future of relationships.

title: वसन्तपुरमा वृद्धमाथि हातपात गर्ने ती युवक अन्ततः प्रहरीको फन्दामा!
description:
काठमाडौंको वसन्तपुर क्षेत्रमा एक वृद्ध मानिसलाई अमानवीय तवरले कुटपिट गर्ने युवकलाई प्रहरीले नियन्त्रणमा लिएको छ। सामाजिक सञ्जालमा भिडियो भाइरल भएलगत्तै जिल्ला प्रहरी परिसर काठमाडौंले एक्सन लिँदै ती व्यक्तिलाई पक्राउ गरेको हो।

नमस्ते साथीहरू, हिजोदेखि सामाजिक सञ्जालमा एउटा बिझाउने भिडियो भाइरल भइरहेको थियो, जहाँ वसन्तपुरको खुल्ला ठाउँमा एकजना वृद्ध बामाथि निर्दयी तरिकाले हातपात गरिएको थियो। यो दृश्यले हामी सबैको मन रोएको थियो। तर आज एउटा सकारात्मक समाचार आएको छ।

title: August 7th & 8th | Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei” | Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com
description:
August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. Late entry may be restricted during the performance. No outside food or beverages permitted. Recording and flash photography may be restricted.

description:
Ada Derana | ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ විශ්වසනීය හා ප්‍රමුඛතම පුවත් සපයන්නා

හොරණ රෝහල් පොලීසියේ සැරයන්ට පහරදීලා | සැරයන් රෝහලේ | සැකකරු සොයා විමර්ශන

හොරණ මූලික රෝහලේ රෝහල් පොලීසියේ සේවයේ නියුතු පොලිස් සැරයන්වරයකුට පහරදී බරපතළ තුවාල සිදුකළ බව කියන පුද්ගලයෙකු අත්අඩංගුවට ගැනීම සඳහා විමර්ශන ආරම්භ කර ඇති බව හොරණ මූලස්ථාන පොලීසිය පවසයි.

පොලීසිය සඳහන් කළේ, හොරණ මූලික රෝහලේ හදිසි අනතුරු හා හදිසි ප්‍රතිකාර ඒකකයේ ප්‍රතිකාර ලබමින් සිටි සිය පියා බැලීමට බීමතින් රෝහලට පැමිණි සැකකරු රෝහල් කාර්ය මණ්ඩලයට පරුෂ වචනයෙන් බැණ වැදී අශෝභන ලෙස හැසිරී ඇති බවයි.

එම අවස්ථාවේ රෝහලේ ආරක්ෂක නිලධාරිණියක විසින් ඔහුට රෝහල් පරිශ්‍රයෙන් පිටතට යන ලෙස දැනුම් දී තිබුණද, එය නොතකා රැඳී සිට ඇති බව පොලිසිය කියයි. 

අනතුරුව ආරක්ෂක නිලධාරියෙකු ඔහු පිටතට යැවීමට උත්සාහ කිරීමේදී ඇති වූ උණුසුම් තත්ත්වය පාලනය කිරීම සඳහා රෝහල් පොලීසියේ පොලිස් සැරයන්වරයා මැදිහත් වූ අවස්ථාවේ සැකකරු ඔහුට පහරදී ඇති බව විමර්ශනවලදී අනාවරණය වී ඇත.

මෙම සිද්ධියට පෙර සැකකරු සහ රෝහලේ වෛද්‍යවරයකු අතර බහින්බස්වීමක් ද ඇතිව තිබූ බවට තොරතුරු වාර්තා වන බව පොලීසිය සඳහන් කළේය.

පහරදීමෙන් පොලිස් සැරයන්වරයාගේ හිසට බරපතළ තුවාල සිදුවී ඇති අතර, ඔහු මේ වන විට හොරණ මූලික රෝහලේ ප්‍රතිකාර ලබමින් සිටියි. 

එමෙන්ම රෝහලේ ආරක්ෂක නිලධාරියකුට සහ ආරක්ෂක නිලධාරිණියකට ද සැකකරු පහරදී ඇති බව පොලීසිය පවසයි.

අනතුරුව සැකකරු මෝටර් රථයකින් පලාගොස් ඇති අතර, එම අවස්ථාවේ රෝහලේ ආරක්ෂක නිලධාරිණියක විසින් සැකකරු පලාගිය මෝටර් රථයේ අංකය ඡායාරූපගත කර තිබීම හේතුවෙන් විමර්ශන සඳහා වැදගත් තොරතුරු ලැබී ඇති බව පොලීසිය සඳහන් කළේය.

සැකකරුගේ පියා සිද්ධිය වන අවස්ථාවේ හොරණ මූලික රෝහලේ හදිසි අනතුරු හා හදිසි ප්‍රතිකාර ඒකකයේ ප්‍රතිකාර ලබමින් සිටි බවද වාර්තා වේ.

සැකකරු අත්අඩංගුවට ගැනීම සඳහා විමර්ශන ක්‍රියාත්මක වන අතර, හොරණ වැඩබලන මූලස්ථාන පොලිස් පරීක්ෂක පරාක්‍රම ගුණවර්ධන මහතාගේ උපදෙස් මත හොරණ මූලස්ථාන පොලීසිය වැඩිදුර පරීක්ෂණ සිදු කරයි.

August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. description:
සාමාන්‍යයෙන් මට සතියකට 3-4ක් වගේ කතා කරනවා එයාලගේ ජීවිත වල යම්කිසි කතාවක් කියන්න. මම ඉතින් ගොඩක් වෙලාවට ඒවා අහගෙන ඉන්නවා, උපදෙස් දෙනවා නම් අඩුයි ඒත් එයාලා මට කතා කරන්නේ යම්කිසි හේතුවක් ඇතුව කියලා හිතන නිසා මම අහගෙන ඉන්නවා. 

දැනට මම මේ වගේ කතා 800කට වඩා අහලා තියනවා. මේ අව්රුද්දෙ ඒ කියන්නේ 2025 වසරේ විතරම් මම එහෙම කතා 214ක් අහලා තියනවා. මේවා මටත් ජීවිතය පිලිබඳ ගැඹුරෙන් හිතන්න උදව් වෙනවා, අපි හැමෝගෙම සිතුම් පැතුම්,  අපි හොයන දේවල් අපේ වැරදි, අපේ අත්වැරදී මේ සේරම මම අහගෙන ඉන්නවා. 

එහෙම අහගෙන ඉඳලා මම ඒවා ගැන ටිකක් හිතනවා. ඇයි එහෙම වෙන්නේ, කොහොමද කෙනෙක් එහෙම කරන්නේ. මේ ගොඩක් කතා අතුරින් ඇහෙන පොදු කරුණු 4ක් විතර මට අද බෙදාගන්න තියනවා. 

ඉස්සරහ දිහා ටිකක් පුළුල් විදිහට බලන හැමෝටම මේවා වැදගත් වේවි කියලා හිතුනා.

අනතුර හේතුවෙන් කුපිත වූ දාගොන්න ප්‍රදේශයේ ප්‍රදේශවාසීන් විසින් අනතුරට හේතු වූ කන්ටේනර් රථයට ගිනිතබා ඇත.

අදාළ ප්‍රහාරය සම්බන්ධයෙන් රුසියානු ආරක්ෂක අමාත්‍යාංශය පවසා ඇත්තේ, හමුදා අරමුණු සඳහා භාවිතා කරන සැපයුම් මධ්‍යස්ථාන ඉලක්ක කර මෙම ප්‍රහාරය එල්ල කළ බවය.

title: 📜✨ The Sovereign Light of Buddha Mātā - Epic Choral Orchestra Anthem (නමෝ නමෝ අමා මෑණි බුදුමව්)✨
description:
📜 "The Sovereign Light of Buddha Mātā" 📜 
- Epic Choral Orchestra Anthem - 
 (නමෝ නමෝ අමා මෑණි බුදු මව්)

Experience a grand, majestic choral declaration of deep Buddhist devotion and heritage. This track is a meticulous six-stanza English verse translation and adaptation of the profoundly moving Sinhala devotional masterpiece, "නමෝ නමෝ අමා මෑණි බුදු මව්" (Namo Namo Ama Mæni Budu Mav). 

Moving completely away from passive ambient textures, this version scales the heavens with a powerful mixed male and female choir, sweeping orchestral string arrangements, and stately brass fanfares at a solemn 85 BPM. 

From the opening praise of the Great Noble Mother to the raw spiritual battles against the Mara hosts, this anthem carries the listener through advanced stages of meditative insight—concluding with a humble, devout aspiration to stand as authentic sons before Her Diamond Throne. 

✨ Music Style: Stately Choral Anthem / Epic Orchestral Brass / Patriotic & Inspiring
✍️ Original Song: නමෝ නමෝ අමා මෑණි බුදු මව් (Namo Namo Ama Mæni Budu Mav)


📜 "The Sovereign Light of Buddha Mātā" - Epic Choral Orchestra Anthem (නමෝ නමෝ අමා මෑණි බුදුමව්)

[Chorus]
All praise and honor... O Great Buddha Mātā's grace,
The Noble, life-bestowing Mother of our mortal race!
She preaches to destroy the wood that feeds the worldly flame,
While far across the ten frontiers, Her blessed words proclaim!
නමෝ නමෝ අමා මෑණි බුදු මව් 
මහා අරිය මාතා 
භව ගිනි දෙන දර සුන්කර දෙසනා 
සුන්දර සිරි බස දසතා 

[Verse 1]
She grants the high meditative states, the Path's eternal fruit,
And guides to Victory's Land, where peace has taken root.
Destroying all our debts to Death, She breaks the chains of old,
Securing pure Nirvanic bliss, eternal in Her fold.
අරිය ධ්‍යාන සහ මගපල ලැබදී 
ජයබිම වෙත මග කියනා
මරු ණය නසනා ජීවනය දෙමින් 
අමා නිවන් සැප සදනා 

[Verse 2]
To clearly see the Four Noble Truths, with wisdom and with might,
She shatters cold Avidya's dark, bestowing spiritual light.
Against the heavy Mara hosts, when Buddhist forces stand,
Taking refuge in the Buddha is the strength of all our band
සිව් අරි සස් දැකගන්නා
ඥාණ විරිය වඩවමිනා
අවිඳු අඳුර හැම නසනා
ආලෝකය ඉන් දෙවනා

[Verse 3]
We seek refuge and strength within the Noble Triple Gem,
To fight the earthly war and place our total trust in Them.
By hearing, retaining, and practicing the Dhamma clear,
We guard our heritage to drive away all doubt and fear.
මරු හා බොදු අපගේ සටනේ 
ශක්තිය වේ බුදුසරණේ 
තෙරුවණ (දම් ඇසීම, දැරීම, හැසිරීම) බොදු උරුමේ 
බැතියෙන් යමු සරණේ 

[Verse 4]
With an awakened mind to crush the subtle Mara horde,
Through mindful reflection's edge, existence is abhorred.
Beholding pure Nirvana as our true, intended place,
We move directly to achieve absolute liberation’s space.
පරදන්නට මරු පිබිදුණු මනසින් 
සතිමත් අනුපස්සනාවෙනා 
මුඛ (මුඛ්‍ය) නිමිත්ත දුටු නිවනම දකිමින් 
විමුක්තියටමයි ඇදෙනා 

[Verse 5]
Realizing all the truths our Mother has made known,
We stand as Her authentic sons before Her diamond throne.
Without delay or falling back to Samsara's tempting wheel,
Let us bow to the Buddha Mātā with a deep, devoted zeal!
අමා මෑණිගේ යතාර්ථයෙහි වන් 
නියම බුදුපුතුන් වෙන්ටා 
පමා නොවී භවයට නොඇදී 
අපි වඳිමු අමාමව් බුදු මාතා 

All praise and honor...to the Mother we adore,
All praise and honor...now and evermore!
නමෝ නමෝ නමෝ නමෝ බුදුමාතා 
නමෝ නමෝ නමෝ නමෝ බුදුමාතා 

-----
🙏 If this majestic composition inspired strength or peace on your path, please LIKE, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE. May all beings be liberated from the bonds of existence. Podhuve Semata Suwa Wewa.

title: August 7th & 8th | Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei” | Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com
description:
August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. Late entry may be restricted during the performance. No outside food or beverages permitted. Recording and flash photography may be restricted.

title: Insta360 | How to Transfer Photos to Computer
description:
In this video, we’ll show you how to use Insta360 Studio to convert .insp photos from Insta360 cameras into JPG format.

The .insp format contains unstitched 360 images. While it’s easy to use the Insta360 Studio app on your phone to stitch these images into 360 photos and transfer them directly, you might need to work with them on a desktop computer. To do this, connect your camera to your computer using a USB-C cable, copy the .insp files to your computer, and then open Insta360 Studio. Simply drag and drop the files into the application.

A key step during the export process is selecting the 360 image option, as this is not the default setting. By following this method, you can seamlessly convert your 360 photos into JPG format for use on your desktop.

description:
✨ "Source of Protection" (Deep Chilled Folktronica Blessing) ✨

Take a moment to center yourself and find absolute calm. This track is a unique, alternative electronic-acoustic production—blending the modern textures of deep organic chill and sacred folktronica with a raw, raspy male vocal delivery and a grounded 88 BPM tempo.

The lyrics illuminate the ultimate protective meaning of the 'Pañca Māra Jitō Nāthō' chant. It celebrates our Lord, the Accomplished One, who triumphed completely over the fivefold forces of Mara to provide a true refuge and shelter for the helpless worldlings of Samsara. By preaching the Four Noble Truths, He opened the gateway to salvation. May the power of this reverent homage shatter all fears, hazards, and dangers without a trace, cooling all minds in the serene peace of the deathless Nibbana.

If this earnest, deeply moving blessing brings safety and tranquility to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with fellow travelers on the path. ☸️🛡️🌾

📖 LYRICS 

🎵🌟 Having defeated the fivefold Mara's might (පංච මාර ජිතෝ නාථෝ) 🌟🎵 ☸පංච මාර ජිතෝ නාථෝ - ගාථා අර්ථය   ☸The Meaning of the chant 'paṁca māra jitō nāthō'☸

🌟 Verse 1: Victory Over the Fivefold Mara
Having defeated the fivefold Mara's might,
He claimed the refuge of the supreme light.
Attaining perfect Buddhahood, noble and deathless,
Our Lord, the Accomplished One, gives refuge to the helpless.
පස් මරුන් පරදා තෙදින්, නාථ බව ලැබගත් නිතින් 
උතුම් සම්බුදුබවට පත්වුණි, අප මහා සම්බුදු රජුන් 

🌟 Verse 2: Preaching the Four Noble Truths
For those left helpless in Samsara's dangerous space,
The well-meaning Buddha brought His loving grace.
Preaching the Four Noble Truths to set them free,
I bow my head with faithful heart to His majesty.
අනාථව සිටිනා දනන්, මුදාලන සිත ගෙන මෙතින් 
සිව් අරිය සස් දෙසන බුදු රජ, වඳින්නේ මම බැති සිතින් 

🌟 Verse 3: The Power of Homage
By the boundless power of this holy praise,
May all hazards and worries end their days.
Let countless fears and dangers leave no trace,
Shattered completely by His ultimate grace.
එම නමස්කාරේ බලෙන්, සියළු බය අන්තරාවන්
සෑම උවදුරු ඉතිරි නොමවී, වැනසිලා සෙත සැදීයන් 

🌟 Verse 4: The Wish for Nibbana
May all living beings, along with my own mind,
Be fully appeased and leave all grief behind.
With serene hearts, free from all painful sighs,
May we cool down where the deathless Nibbana lies.

title: August 7th & 8th | Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei” | Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com
description:
August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. Late entry may be restricted during the performance. No outside food or beverages permitted. Recording and flash photography may be restricted.

title: The Online Movement Helping Women Leave Dangerous Relationships
description:
Why are so many women sharing advice online about how to leave abusive relationships safely? Across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and private online communities, women are exchanging safety planning tips, escape strategies, emergency checklists, financial preparation, and resources for survivors of domestic violence. As these conversations become more visible, many people are asking what they reveal about modern relationships, abuse, and the growing demand for safety and accountability.

When leaving becomes a survival plan, the conversation extends far beyond one relationship. It raises questions about domestic violence, coercive control, emotional abuse, psychological abuse, intimate partner violence, and the challenges survivors face when trying to leave safely. It also highlights the role communities, advocates, and online support networks play in helping people recognize abuse and seek help.

In this video, we’re exploring why these conversations are growing, what they may reveal about our culture, and why safety planning has become such an important topic for so many women. We’ll also discuss accountability, prevention, emotional intelligence, healthy relationships, and how stronger communities can help reduce violence before lives are lost.

This discussion is not about blaming all men. It is about understanding abuse, supporting survivors, encouraging healthy relationships, and examining the social conditions that allow abuse to continue behind closed doors. Healthy relationships are built on respect, empathy, trust, communication, and mutual safety. Abuse thrives in silence. Awareness, education, and community support can save lives.

If you or someone you know is experiencing abuse, please seek help from trusted friends, family, local support organizations, or trained domestic violence professionals. You deserve to be safe.

I want to hear from you.

Why do you think more women are sharing safety planning advice online today than ever before?

title: Lehenga ❤️ #shorts
🎶⬥💎Samsara: The Haunted Toybox: An Eerie Cinematic Song of Endless Suffering🎶💎 (ජීවිතයම ගොඩ නගනට)🎶⬥💎
description:
Samsara: The Haunted Toybox: An Eerie Cinematic Song of Endless Suffering (ජීවිතයම ගොඩ නගනට)

"We open up our eyes to toil beneath the sun, then vanish in the dark when all our days are done..." 

Welcome to a haunting, psychological horror adaptation of a deeply philosophical journey. "Samsara: The Haunted Toybox" reimagines the ancient eastern concept of the endless cycle of suffering (Samsara) through the chilling lens of a dark, mechanical dollhouse aesthetic. 

Driven by the fragile, detuned melodies of an old wind-up music box, toy pianos, and eerie, atmospheric whispers, this track contrasts innocence with the crushing existential weight of human existence. The body is treated as a clockwork doll—trapped, repeating its motions of birth, struggle, and loss over and over again, begging for an escape from the loop.

If you connected with the dark, melancholic, and unsettling atmosphere of this track, please leave a comment, like the video, and subscribe to the channel for more dark cinematic art.
---
Lyrics:


(Verse 1)
I watch the endless struggle of the human hand
To build a life upon the shifting, heavy sand
ජීවිතයම ගොඩ නගනට දුක් විඳිනා මිනිසුන් දකිමි

Yet all they build collapses underneath their eyes
The weight of sorrow falls from unforgiving skies
ඒ ජීවිතයම කඩාන උන්හිස මත වැටෙනව දකිමි

(Verse 2)
They chase a fleeting joy with every breath they take
A desperate fight for peace, for every second's sake
හැම තත්පරේම සතුටින් ඉන්නට දඟලන හැටි දකිමි

But earned through bitter tears and agonizing pain
The fleeting pleasure fades, and only wounds remain
දුක් විඳලා ලද සැප මොහොතකින්ම නැති වී යනු දකිමි

(Verse 3)
In a world where no one wins, who holds the final crown?
If staying at the top just drags you further down?
හැමදාමත් දිනන්න බැරි ලොව ජය කාහටද හිමි

To win and win again, a race that never ends—
Is it a triumph won, or loss that life extends?
දිනුවත් නැවතත් දිනන්න වේ නම් පැරදුම නොවෙද හිමි

(Verse 4)
We open up our eyes to toil beneath the sun
Then vanish in the dark when all our days are done
ඉපදී දහදුක් විඳලා ආපහු මැරිලා යනු දකිමි

We journey to the grave with heavy, empty hands
No comfort or reward across these barren lands
මැරිලා යනකොට ලද සැනසීමක් නැතිබව නම් දකිමි

(Chorus)
In a world where no one wins, who holds the final crown?
If victory means fighting just to tear another down?
හැමදාමත් දිනන්න බැරි ලොව ජය කාහටද හිමි

To win and win again, a race that never ends—
Is it a triumph won, or loss that life extends?
දිනුවත් නැවතත් දිනන්න වේ නම් පැරදුම නොවෙද හිමි

(Bridge)
Oh, when will it subside, this wheel of endless pain?
The tide of Samsara, washing up the shore again?
ආපහු ඉපදී මැරෙනා සසරේ දුක් කඳ වේද නිමි

I choose to walk away from pleasures bought with tears
From burdens wrapped in joy throughout the passing years
නැවත නැවත යළි දුක් විඳලා සැප ගන්නට මම නොයමි

(Outro)
Dear Mother, if you love me, hear my final plea
මට ආදරයක් වේ නම් අම්මේ මම වැඳලා කියමි
Show me the quiet path to finally walk free
සසරෙන් බේරී යන මග පෙන්වා දෙන මෙන් මම යදිමි
Dear Father, though your shelter guards me from the cold
Your safety cannot save me from the loops of old
පිය රැකවරණය අද තිබුණට සසරේ වනු ඇත අහිමි
Guide me from the cycle, break this heavy chain
Show me the way to freedom, far beyond the pain
සසරෙන් බේරී යන මග පෙන්වා මෙන් මම යදිමි

at Musaeus College Auditorium

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.

description:
🌊දිය සුලිද රකුසන් පිරී (Filled with monsters and whirlpools deep)🌊

පැවැත්මේ (භවයේ) සැඟවුණු බියකරු බව මනාව හෙළිදරව් කරමින්, තෙරුවන් සරණ සහ කල්‍යාණ මිත්‍රයන් නමැති උතුම් පිළිසරණෙහි ඇති අගය උත්කර්ෂයට නංවන, සිත ප්‍රබෝධමත් කරවන සිනමාත්මක ආධ්‍යාත්මික චාරිකාවකට ඔබව සාදරයෙන් පිළිගනිමු.මෙම නිර්මාණය, ශාන්ත සිනමාත්මක සමුද්‍රීය සංගීත ශෛලියකින් (Soft Epic High-Seas Symphony) යුක්තව නිමවා ඇති ධම්ම ගීතයකි. 

[Verse 1]
Filled with monsters and whirlpools deep,
Down in Samsara’s ocean, the shadows steep.
I drifted helpless toward a tragic end,
Trapped in the floods where illusions blend.
දිය සුලිද රකුසන් පිරී සංසාර සයුරෙහි වැටී 
විනාසය වෙත ගියේ ඇදී සංසාර ඕගෙහි රැඳී 

[Verse 2]
Extending His hand with comforting grace,
He pulled me out to a safer space.
Into the pure gentle stream, cooling and clear,
He led me to peace, saying, "Hasten, the end is near."
සුරත දී බේරාන මා සුනිල දිය ගලනා අමා 
සෝතයෙහි හැරලූ මෙමා නිවෙනු කී නොම වී පමා 

[Verse 3]
Starting from Buddha’s saving, sacred hand,
A chain of noble friends form a protective band.
With pure benevolence, so deep and kind,
They give us wisdom, breaking every bind.
බුදුන්ගේ සුරතින් පටන්ගෙන කලණ මිතුරන් පෙළ සැදී 
මෙත් සිතින් අසරණ සරණ වෙත සර නසන්නට නුවණ දී 

[Verse 4]
Before this fence of noble friends recede,
And darkness falls upon the worldlings' creed,
May all reap blessings, reach the blissful shore,
And see Nirvana’s supreme bliss for evermore.
ඒ කළණ වැට දිනෙක අවරට යන්න මත්තෙන් ලෝ සැමා 
පින් ඵලය දී සැපත් වන වෙත නිවන් දස්සන බිම අමා

[Outro]
And see Nirvana’s supreme bliss for evermore...
සැපත් වන වෙත නිවන් දස්සන බිම අමා...

Our Pro guide :  0743662911 ( Mr.Piyal )
Nuwaragala is an ancient fortress and monastery which is situated along the Mahiyangane-Dimbulagala-Dalukkane Highway in Ampara. A paved pathway made of stone leads to the top of the mountain and to a large cave, which can easily house about 150 persons.
It is believed to be the hideout place of King Saddatissa during his time of bitterness with his brother King Dutugemunu. According to renowned archaeologist Ellawala Medhananda Thera, Nuwaragala was a monastery built by King Lajja Thissa, who ruled the country from 119 to 109 BC.

description:
🎵 Title: The Glob of Foam (පෙණ පිඬුව)🎼 A Technical Manual for the Five Aggregates (James Blunt Acoustic Style)

Deconstruct the heavy illusions of our existence with this raw, intimate, and deeply emotional Industrial metal (with progressive rock influences) exploration of the Phena Pindu Sutta. Arranged in the signature style of a 2000s indie folk-pop ballad at 82 BPM, this track uses a weeping violin and raw fingerstyle guitar to deliver a literal "technical manual for the mind"—investigating the transient nature of the Five Aggregates (Pancha Khandha).

The lyrics explicitly carry the five classical metaphors spoken by the Buddha: comparing the physical form (Rupa) to a glob of foam, sensations (Vedana) to fleeting water bubbles, perceptions (Sanna) to a deceptive mirage, mental formations (Sankhara) to a hollow banana trunk, and consciousness (Vinnana) to a sorcerer's optical illusion. Guided by a hauntingly repetitive English chorus detailing the four core inversions of existence (Assasatō, Addhuvō, Vipariṇāma Dhammō, Asārō), the track strips away the delusion of self before dissolving into the cooling, absolute peace of Nibbana.

✨ If this deep analytical track brought perspective and calm to your day, please Like, Share, and Subscribe to help spread the Dhamma.

As one bubble shatters on the shifting track...
Yet more arise to take the missing back.
පෙණ කැටිය සැදෙන්නේ බුබුළු එක්වී නොයෙක්
කැඩී යන බුබුළකට තව බුබුළු බැදී එක්

[Verse 4: The Blind Observer]
So long we see the foam that floats as one...
We miss the fleeting parts by which it's done.
Built from separate units, quick to fade,
As newer waves replace the ones decayed.
එක දිගට පවතිනා පෙණ කැටිය දකින තෙක්
කැඩී යන එකතු වෙන බුබුළු ගැන නැහැ වගක්

[Verse 5: The Nameless Form]
All we can find is foam of a transient kind...
No permanent form remains to stay behind.
Can fleeting shapes be called substantinal (object or) matter...
(An individual), or a living being for that matter?
රූපයක් කියන්නේ පිඩු වෙච්ච පෙණ මිසක්
දිගට පවතින යමක් නොවෙයි යම් රූපයක්
එවන් වූ කල ද්‍රව්‍ය, වස්තුවය සත්ත්වයෙක්
පුද්ගලෙක් කිය කියා ගත හැකිද රූපයක්

[Chorus: The Four Inversions]
It does not last, unenduring and fleeting (asāssatō)...
It changes fast, always shape shifting (Addhuvō).
It breaks and shatters on this earthly floor (Vipariṇāma Dhammō)...
Devoid of essence, hollow to the core (Asārō).
නිති නොපවතින දෙයක් (අසාස්සතෝ),
වෙනස් වී යන දෙයක් (අද්ධුවෝ), 
කැඩෙන බිඳෙනා දෙයක් (විපරිණාම ධම්මෝ), 
සාරයක් නැති දෙයක් (අසාරෝ)
  
[Verse 6: The Bubble of Sensation]
Sensations rise like water bubbles in a flash,
Born for a single breath before they crash.
They spark to life through sensory contact,
Then fade away, unable to stay intact.
මතු වෙනා වේදනා දිය බුබුළ වැනි ‍යමක්
මොහොතකින් මතුවෙලා නැතිවෙලා යන දෙයක්

[Verse 7: The Myth of Pleasure]
When contact wakes, cognized then cast away...
The passing feeling cannot choose to stay.
For not all things we touch or feel within...
Can let a lasting, constant joy begin.
සම්පස්සයක් වුනොත් දැනී දුරු වන දෙයක්
දැනෙන හැම දේ නිතර දෙන්නෙ නැහැ නොවැ සැපක්

[Bridge: The Grand Summary of Emptiness]
The glob of foam has no essence, nor does the sense-object.
The water bubble has no essence, nor does the sensation.
The mirage has no essence, nor does the perception.
The banana trunk has no essence, nor does the mental fabrication.
The magic has no essence, nor does the consciousness.
The world has no essence, nor does the cycle of wandering.
පෙණ බුබුළ අසාරයි, රූපය අසාරයි 
දිය බුබුළ අසාරයි, වේදනා අසාරයි 
මිරිගුව අසාරයි, සඥාව අසාරයි 
කෙසෙල් කඳ අසාරයි, සංකාර අසාරයි 
මායාව අසාරයි, විඥාණ අසාරයි

[Outro: The Bliss of Nibbana]

Eternal peace...Eternal release...

දකුණු යුක්‍රේනයේ සිවිල් වැසියෙකු පසුපස ඩ්‍රෝනයක් හඹා යන ආකාරය දැක්වෙන වීඩියෝවක් යුක්රේන ජනාධිපති ව්ලොදිමීර් සෙලෙන්ස්කි ටෙලිග්‍රෑම් මාධ්‍යයට මුදාහැර තිබුණි.

එරට කෙර්සොන් ප්‍රදේශයේ වීදියක කුඩා වෙළෙඳසැලක් පවත්වාගෙන ගිය පුද්ගලයෙකු තම වෙළෙඳසලෙහි සිටියදී ඔහුගේ පසුපස ඩ්‍රෝනයක් හඹා යන අයුරුයි මෙම විඩියෝවේ දැක්වුණේ.

යුක්‍රේන ජනාධිපති සෙලෙන්ස්කි මෙම ප්‍රහාරය මිනිස් දඩයමක් ලෙස හඳුන්වා තිබුණේ රුසියාව තම රටෙහි ජීවත් වන සිවිල් වැසියන් ඉලක්ක කරගන්නා බවට චෝදනා කරමිනි.

title: 🎵 ☀️From the moment of waking up with the sun💡හිරු සමග පිබිදුණු මොහොතේ සිට☀️The radiant dawn anthem🎵
description:
Experience a serene morning start with "From the Moment I Awaken", a beautiful English Buddhist devotional song (Bhakti Gee) accompanied by its traditional Sinhala translation.This peaceful chant captures the essence of Buddhist teachings, focusing on mindfulness, inner wisdom, gratitude toward parents and teachers, and a commitment to non-violence. Let the calming verses soothe your mind, wash away inner impurities like morning dew, and guide you on a path of spiritual peace and devotion to the Supreme Buddha.Perfect for morning meditation, mindfulness practices, or quiet reflection.

🎵 Lyrics (English & Sinhala):

[Verse 1]
From the moment I awaken with the rising sun,
May I hear the voice of truth from everyone. 
Hearing wisdom from my parents and teachers so kind,
May their calming counsel soothe my restless mind.
හිරු සමග පිබිදුණු මොහොතෙ සිට සත්බසම මට ඇසේවා 
ගුරුවරුද මව්පියද සැමගෙන් ඔවා ලැබ සිත නිවේවා 

[Verse 2]
As the morning sun ascends to light the sky,
May the flame of inner wisdom rise up high.
Like the morning dew that fades before the heat,
May the poisons of my mind face full defeat.
උදාවෙන හිරුමඩල වාගේ නැණ පහන් එලි නැගේවා 
හිරු දුටුව පිනි බින්දු වාගේ සිතේ කෙලෙසුන් නැසේවා 

[Verse 3]
Neither through my mind, my body, nor my word,
Will I harm a single being in this world.
With a heart of good-will, pure and hatred-free,
May Nirvana's peace be found by all and me.
සිතින් කය වචනයෙන් කාටත් හිංසාව නැහැ කරන්නේ 
සියලු සතුනට මෙත් සිතින් නිවනමයි මම පතන්නේ 

[Verse 4]
With a cleansed and serene mind, completely bloomed,
I offer Buddha, as His brood for I'm well-groomed.
Walking in Rahula’s footsteps, firm and true,
Father Buddha, I bow down to honor You.
කුණු සුන් කරපු සිතින් බුදුනට කුසුම් පූජා කරන්නේ 
රාහුල හිමි ගත් මගම ගෙන බුදු පියාණන් වඳින්නේ 

I[Verse 5]
Honest in body, speech, and thought; I am bright,
As my inner temple fills with sacred light.
Like Sunitha, I will cultivate each grace,
Spreading Buddha’s boundless virtues through this space.
සිතද කය වචනය අවංකයි ආලෝකයෙන් පිරෙනවා 
බුදුන්ගේ ගුණ ලොවට බෙදනට සුනීතව ගුණ පුරනවා 

[Verse 6]
He who showed the path to end our heavy grief,
Gave unmeasured blessings and supreme relief.
To the Lord of Worlds, Mother Buddha full of grace,
I sing this song of devotion and endless praise
දුක නිවන මග කියා කල සෙත අපමණයි මම දන්නවා 
අමා මෑණී තිලෝගුරු බුදු පියාණන් ගුණ ගයනවා

[Outro]
To the Lord of Worlds, Mother Buddha full of grace,
I sing this song of devotion and endless praise...
අමා මෑණී තිලෝගුරු බුදු පියාණන් ගුණ ගයනවා...

කුජ ග්‍රහයා මිථුන රාශි ගත වීම ඔබේ රැකියාව, ධනය, ආදරය සහ සෞඛ්‍යයට බලපාන්නේ කෙසේද යන්න පිළිබඳව සම්පූර්ණ පලාපල විස්තරය අපි මෙයින් ගෙන එනවා. මේ ප්‍රබල ග්‍රහ මාරුව (Graha maruwa) නිසා ඔබේ ලග්නයට ලැබෙන වාසි සහ පරිස්සම් විය යුතු දේවල් ගැන කල්තියා දැනුවත් වී ඔබේ අනාගතය සාර්ථක කරගන්න. විශේෂයෙන්ම අගෝස්තු මාසයේ ලග්න පලාපල (Lagna palapala) ගැන උනන්දු වන සැමට මෙම තොරතුරු අතිශයින්ම වැදගත් වේවි.

description:
Step into a sweeping, nostalgic journey of deep introspection. This track is an alternative traditional folk production—crafted in the precise style of 1960s baroque pop and dramatic tavern folk, reminiscent of Mary Hopkin's legendary anthems. It pairs a crisp, highly expressive vocal delivery with driving acoustic guitar strumming, mandolin textures, and swelling orchestral string arrangements.

The lyrics illuminate the core realization of the Four Noble Truths (Siv Ari Sas). It details how our five physical senses continuously captivate the mind, giving rise to a false sense of "self" that clings to illusions, burns in the fires of dissent, and remains trapped in a cycle of chaos. The anthem methodically charts the path from seeing this mountain of pain to cultivating the Noble Eightfold Path with mindful care, culminating in a natural, peaceful release as the mind settles and floats effortlessly to the far shore of Nirvana's wake.

If this dramatic and hopeful musical reflection brings clarity and peace to your day, please consider liking, subscribing, and sharing it with fellow seekers on the path. ☸️🎻🌲

---
🎵 TRACK DETAILS 🎵
• Title: The Awakening Stream
• Style: 1960s Traditional Folk / Sweeping Baroque Pop (120 BPM)
• Vocal Style: Crisp, Soaring, and Expressive Delivery
• Core Themes: The Four Noble Truths, Sensory Restraint, and Nirvana's Wake

---
📖 LYRICS 📖


The Awakening Stream: A Vintage Acoustic Journey Through the Arising and Cessation of Suffering

🌟 Verse 1: To See Suffering, Not Just Endure It
Journeying in pain through Samsara's long track,
The worldlings begin to see the burdens they pack.
The Buddha’s great voice in the cosmos is known:
To see what suffering is, not endure it alone.
සසර ගමනක් දුක් විඳන් ආ - ලෝ සතුන් දුක දකිනවා
විඳින්නට නොව දකින්නට දුක - බුදු බණක් ලොව ඇහෙනවා

🌟 Verse 2: The Illusion of "Mine"
The things heard, seen, and felt with the senses,
Captivate minds, going past defences.
A false sense of "self" arises to blind,
Tasting the world thinking, "This is all mine."
ඇහෙන පෙනෙනා විඳින දේවල් - බොහෝ කොට මන බඳිනවා
මම කියා ජාතියක් හටගෙන - මගේ යයි ලොව විඳිනවා

🌟 Verse 3: Clinging to Pleasure
"This is truly pleasant, essential, and bright,"
They think as they cling to a fleeting delight.
But the wise who wake up to the suffering here,
See that clinging itself leads to suffering's sphere.
හරි සැපයි සාරයි සුභයි නොවැ - කියා සැපෙහිම ඇලෙනවා
දුක දකින සත එසේ ඇලුනේ - දුකෙහි බව දැන් දකිනවා

🌟 Verse 4: Bound by Attachment and Dissent
Bound tight by desire to things that are sweet,
Agreeable outcomes are chased as a feat.
But an unpleasant result brings them much grief,
The fire of dissent burns without relief.
ප්‍රියමනාපෙට ගැළපෙනා දේ - කෙරෙහි රාගෙන් බැඳෙනවා
අප්‍රියයි නම් එන විපාකය - ද්වේශ ගින්නෙහි දැවෙනවා

🌟 Verse 5: Burning in Delusion
Attachment feels sweet and dissenting is liked,
In cycles of Chaos that encompass the mind.
The heavy heart refuses to ever let go,
Burning away in delusion's deep woe.
ඇලුම මධුරයි ගැටුම ප්‍රියවෙයි - ඇලුම ගැටුමෙහි බැඳෙනවා
අතහරින්නට හිත දෙන්නෙ නැහැ - මෝහ ගින්නෙහි දැවෙනවා

🌟 Verse 6: The Emergency of Nirvana
In seeking for pleasure and wishing for gain,
The mind has pocketed mountains of pain.
But where no more currents of sorrow arise,
The pure, deathless nectar of Nirvana lies.
සැප පතාගෙන සැප සොයාගෙන - දුක උදාවී තියෙනවා
දුක උදානොවනා තැන අමා - නිවන ඇතිබව පෙනෙනවා

🌟 Verse 7: Dispelling the World
By calming the craving for things we once prized,
I see how this heap of deep grief was devised.
To shatter the world that we build inside,
We stop the arising of Samsara's tide.
පිරිය සිඳ දුටු දුක් ගොඩෙහි යම් - උදාවීමක් තියෙනවා 
දුක හෙවත් ලොව උදාවීමම - දුරුකරන්නට යෙදෙනවා

🌟 Verse 8: Walking the Buddha’s Path
To reach the bright shore where all burning will cease,
I walk on the path of the Buddha's peace.
Restraining all senses from chasing the air,
We cultivate the Noble Path with mindful care.
දුක නිවුණ තැන ලඟා වෙන්නට - දුන් බොදු මගෙහි ඇදෙනවා

🌟 Verse 9: Natural Liberation
By curbing the senses and calming the mind,
Deep Dhamma realizations are cleanly refined.
With no extra choices or volitions to make,
We float to the far shore of Nirvana's wake.

description:
✨ "The Path of Three Fold Light" (Upbeat Folktronica Hymn) ✨

Immerse yourself in a contemporary spiritual journey. This track is a unique fusion of sacred folktronica—blending fast-tempo electronic arpeggios and modern synthesis with organic acoustic fingerpicking and clear, upfront male vocals. 

The lyrics map out the profound, progressive stages of Buddhist practice: moving from material giving (Amisa Dana) to the supreme gift of fearlessness through virtue (Abhaya Dana), transcending even the highest Brahma realms, and culminating in insight meditation (Bhavana) to flower into the Noble Eightfold Path (Ariya Magga).

If this modern electronic reflection brings clarity and energy to your practice, please like, subscribe, and share it with others on the path! ☸️⚡

---
📖 LYRICS BY SECTION 📖

[0:00] Part 1: The Foundations of Giving (Dāna)
Wishing for Buddhahood, the Great Sage of past,
Fulfilled all Perfections through world-cycles vast.
He strove through the eons of sorrow and pain,
To give us the nectar of Nirvana’s reign.
Just giving a treasure that pleases the eyes,
Does not make an offering noble or wise.
The worth of a gift is not measured by show,
But only the pure, lasting fruits it will sow.

For worldly donations are frequently made,
For praise or return in a spiritual trade.
But the Sage perceived that a gift given blind,
Leaves no lasting welfare or peace for the mind.
Though others are helped and their happiness grows,
It secures no protection when your lifetime must close.
At the moment of death, all those outcomes will fade,
What gift will remain from the choices you made?

[Part 2: The Gift of Fearlessness (Sīla)]
Through killing and stealing and lies that deceive,
Blinded by senses, what webs do we weave?
Misconduct brings terror to all things that breathe,
And leaves the unvirtuous burning beneath.
Established in virtue, no terror we send,
We grant all life freedom, and fears find their end.
This gift of fearlessness stands far above,
The highest of fortunes built on kindly love.

Though virtue may lift you to heavenly spheres,
To taste of their pleasures for thousands of years.
When life spans are ended and bright worlds are past,
That merit is spent, and it leaves you at last.
Abandoning desire and unwholesome states,
Renunciation opens up the higher gates.
As a result, within the Brahma realms sublime,
One walks for world-cycles, beyond the sensual grime.

[Part 3: Transcending Existence & Settling the Debt]
Yet even worldly righteousness will fade away,
This cosmic gift of virtue must at last decay.
If the final outcome is just to be reborn,
It holds no lasting meaning for a heart forlorn.
To find the absolute and ultimate design,
The Sage spent long times in inquiry divine.
Realizing Nibbana at the sacred Bodhi tree,
The final Perfections were fulfilled to set us free.

Sharing this great meaning with all things that breathe,
One cools the burning agony that rages underneath.
For of all the donations across the cosmic space,
The gift of Truth stands highest, granting final grace.
Upon the weary journey through Samsara's sweeping track,
We serve our sentence, paying those heavy debt back.
But walking on the path of pure and noble giving,
We drop the lingering burden and settle all our living.

[Part 4: The Reality of Senses & Mental Development (Bhāvanā)]
We constantly carry this filth fed by the senses' might,
Piled deep in our minds through the day and the night.
Out of greed for the pleasures of the sensual form,
We feast on the senses and fuel the raging storm.
From a desperate craving to capture a view,
An eye has been crafted, born to build life anew.
Bearing a body that is bound to decay,
We suffer the karmic results day by day.

Yet mundane gifts pave the way for the mind,
To hear the True Dhamma and leave the world behind.
For supporting the Sangha with requisites pure,
Great spiritual guidance is granted as the cure.
The Noble Ones offer their guidance and light,
Rooted deeply in Truth to dispel the dark night.
The immortal nectar the Buddha once gave,
Is shared through the Dhamma to comfort and save.

The moment one hears how the True Dhamma cools,
The mind longs to vomit the errors of fools.
Extinguishing greed through the choices we make,
We conquer the miserly thoughts we forsake.
Seeing all living beings in world-systems wide,
Enduring the pain of the samsaric tide.
Grand compassion and benevolence wake in the mind,
Wishing only Nibbana’s great peace for the living kind.

[The Climax: The Ariya Magga]
Through giving and virtue and mental release,
The path of practice is fulfilled in deep peace.
From it blossoms the Noble Path, sweeping and grand,
Yielding the highest fruit beyond this cosmic land.

August 7th & 8th
Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. title: 🌊Filled with monsters and whirlpools deep (දිය සුලිද රකුසන් පිරී) — A slow majestic maritime march🌊
description:
Welcome to a deeply moving, cinematic spiritual journey that exposes the hidden perils of existence and celebrates the ultimate refuge found in the Triple Gem and noble spiritual friends (Kalyana Mittas).

This track is an English Dhamma song crafted in a Soft Epic High-Seas Symphony style. Set at a steady, majestic 82 BPM, the arrangement perfectly mirrors a cinematic maritime march. It pairs a delicate grand piano, crying orchestral string ensembles, and melancholic woodwinds with a deep, soaring operatic male tenor. Supported by warm atmospheric synth pads, the instrumentation builds an evocative wave of spiritual urgency (Dhamma Samvega), capturing the tragic cry of a soul drowning in the monstrous whirlpools of Samsara, and the ultimate relief of being pulled into the cooling stream of Dhamma (Sotapatti).

The lyrics vividly portray the "fence of noble friends"—the lineage of spiritual guides stretching back to the Buddha's own saving hand—who give us the wisdom to shatter our attachments before spiritual darkness blankets the worldlings' creed.

✨ Perfect for: Deep meditation, Dhamma reflection, mindfulness, overcoming attachment, and cinematic soundscape relaxation.

[Verse 1]
Filled with monsters and whirlpools deep,
Down in Samsara’s ocean, the shadows steep.
I drifted helpless toward a tragic end,
Trapped in the floods where illusions blend.
දිය සුලිද රකුසන් පිරී සංසාර සයුරෙහි වැටී 
විනාසය වෙත ගියේ ඇදී සංසාර ඕගෙහි රැඳී 

[Verse 2]
Extending His hand with comforting grace,
He pulled me out to a safer space.
Into the pure gentle stream, cooling and clear,
He led me to peace, saying, "Hasten, the end is near."
සුරත දී බේරාන මා සුනිල දිය ගලනා අමා 
සෝතයෙහි හැරලූ මෙමා නිවෙනු කී නොම වී පමා 

[Verse 3]
Starting from Buddha’s saving, sacred hand,
A chain of noble friends form a protective band.
With pure benevolence, so deep and kind,
They give us wisdom, breaking every bind.
බුදුන්ගේ සුරතින් පටන්ගෙන කලණ මිතුරන් පෙළ සැදී 
මෙත් සිතින් අසරණ සරණ වෙත සර නසන්නට නුවණ දී 

[Verse 4]
Before this fence of noble friends recede,
And darkness falls upon the worldlings' creed,
May all reap blessings, reach the blissful shore,
And see Nirvana’s supreme bliss for evermore.
ඒ කළණ වැට දිනෙක අවරට යන්න මත්තෙන් ලෝ සැමා 
පින් ඵලය දී සැපත් වන වෙත නිවන් දස්සන බිම අමා

[Outro]
And see Nirvana’s supreme bliss for evermore...
සැපත් වන වෙත නිවන් දස්සන බිම අමා...

description:

a person standing on a single spinning bamboo log…
floating down a river without falling.

and mastering it can take years.

In this video, discover how people travel and perform on nothing but a rolling piece of bamboo.

✅ See how the bamboo spins under your feet with every shift of weight

What looks like balance…
is actually constant movement and control.

Some experts even perform martial arts while drifting —
turning a river into a stage.

It’s not just transportation.
It’s precision, timing, and years of training —
all on a surface that never stops moving.

Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.

title: 🌾The Illusion of the Paddy Field (Acoustic Country Folk Version)🌾-(ගොයම් කන්න මම කුඹුරට පැන්නා)
description:
🌾 "The Illusion of the Paddy Field" (Acoustic Country Folk Version) 🌾

Experience a deeply personal, soulful journey through the mechanics of desire and karmic liberation. This track is a meticulous six-stanza English verse translation and adaptation of the beloved, allegorical Sinhala Buddhist masterpiece, "ගොයම් කන්න මම කුඹුරට පැන්නා" (Goyam Kanna Mama Kumburata Pænnā).

Moving away from grand choral or electronic scales, this version reimagines the track as a 1970s warm acoustic folk ballad in the timeless style of John Denver's "Country Roads." The rural metaphors of the song—an animal repeatedly sneaking into a lush paddy field to feed, only to face the harsh blows of the farmers—sit perfectly within a nostalgic, organic Americana landscape of finger-picked guitars, soaring fiddles, and heartfelt vocal storytelling. 

It tracks a traveler wandering a dusty, punishing worldly road, realizing the futility of chasing fleeting sensory pleasures, paying off ancient debts to beings, and finally yearning for the ultimate, peaceful home that waits beyond the worldly skies.

✨ Music Style: 70s Acoustic Country Folk / Nostalgic Americana / Heartfelt Storytelling
✍️ Original Song: ගොයම් කන්න මම කුඹුරට පැන්නා (Goyam Kanna Mama Kumburata Pænnā)

📜 "The Illusion of the Paddy Field" | "The Illusion of the Paddy Field" (ගොයම් කන්න මම)

[Chorus - The Metaphor of Desire]
I jumped into the paddy field to taste the green array,
But farmers beat me fiercely there and drove my form away!
(ගොයම් කන්න මම කුඹුරට පැන්නා; ගජරාමෙට ගුටිකන්න වුනේ)
Yet back into the lush domain, my craving heart would creep,
To feast upon the growing grains, while endless sorrows reap!
(කුඹුරක් දැක්කම ආපහු පැනලා; කාගෙන යන්නම සිත් දුන්නේ)

[Verse 1 - Breaking the Cycle]
When I jumped in to taste again, they beat me in a ring,
Intolerable pain and grief was all their blows could bring.
(ආපහු පැන්නම වට කරගෙන මට; තැලුවා කොහොමද ඉවසන්නේ) 
Though hunger claims my fading breath, I'll never venture near,
To chase after the transient fruits of worldly hope and fear.
(මට නම් බැහැ කුඹුරට ගොඩ වෙන්නට; මැරිල ගියත් මම බඩගින්නේ)

[Verse 2 - Chasing False Solace]
We wander through a punishing world of unfulfilled desire,
Chasing after futile grace to feed an endless fire.
(අනිසය දුක අනතය ඇති ලෝකේ; අස්සාදය සොයමින් යන්නේ)
No matter how we search the earth, no lasting peace is found,
For only deep, unceasing grief is chained to worldly ground.
(ගුටිකනවා මිස කොච්චර හෙව්වත්; සැනසුම නැහැ එහි පවතින්නේ)

[Verse 3 - The Purification & Karmic Debt]
The words of Buddha cleared my path and washed my stains aside,
Yet heavy shadows from my dark past still follow; I cannot hide.
(බුදුබණ අහලා යහමග වැටිලා; තරමක් සුද්ද වෙලා ඉන්නේ / හොඳ කෙරුවට අද සසරේ කළ පව්; තාමත් පස්සෙන් පන්නන්නේ)
These hardships force my spiritual drive to wake without delay,
To seek the peace Nirvana brings and find the righteous way!
(සසරේ ආවේ සුදනෙක් ලෙස නොව; එන අකුසලයෙන් දැනගන්නේ / අනතුර පෙන්නා පමා නොවන්නට; තල්ලුවකුයි ਕਰදර දෙන්නේ)

[Verse 4 - Awakening Compassion]
No longer trapped in worldly fights to grasp at earthly gold,
Though others come to rival me, my anger is controlled.
(හොඳ දේ අල්ලන්නට බලු පොරයට; කොහොමද ආපහු බැහැ ගන්නේ / තරගෙට ආවට මාත් එක්ක මුං; පෙර මෙන් නැහැ තරහක් එන්නේ)
Seeing the blind and helpless world, trapped in Avidya's night,
Goodwill and deepest compassion wake my inner sight.
(සාරයි කියලා අන්ධ වෙලා නොවැ; ලෝක සත්වයන් පසුවන්නේ / අසරණ කම උන්ගේ මට පෙනිලා; කරුණා මෙත් සිත උපදින්නේ)

[Verse 5 - Balancing the Karmic Debt]
Reflecting on the Triple Gem, a river wells within,
A tide of pure and sacred merit washes away my sin.
(බුදුගුණ දම්ගුණ සඝගුණ දැකලා; පින් ගංගා මතුකරගන්නේ) 
I share these fruits with those I wronged to break the karmic chain,
Paying my ancient debts to beings, to soothe the lingering pain.

title: Were Women Conditioned to Be Delusional?
description:
What if everything women were taught about love, relationships, marriage, and men wasn’t the whole story?

From fairy tales and princess movies to toys, television, family traditions, and the roles many girls are encouraged to play, countless messages shape expectations long before adulthood.

But what happens when those expectations collide with real life?

In this video, we’ll discuss how cultural narratives influence our expectations, and why so many women later find themselves questioning ideas they once accepted without hesitation. Also,The stories girls grow up watching,The toys and roles they’re encouraged to embrace,How expectations about love and relationships are formed,The difference between cultural narratives and lived experience,Why some women feel disillusioned as adults and Whether these expectations still serve women today.

This isn’t a video about blaming women or blaming men.

It’s about asking where our beliefs come from, whether they reflect reality, and what happens when the stories we’ve inherited no longer match the lives we’re living.

What do you think? Were women taught unrealistic expectations, or have these ideas simply changed over time? Join the conversation respectfully in the comments.

description:
Do you want to learn how to make English sentences from scratch? 🤔

Many Sri Lankan English learners know a lot of English words, but they still struggle to put those words in the correct order and make a complete sentence. 😟

👉 The good news is that you don't need to memorize thousands of sentences.

In this video, I explain how to make English sentences step by step from the very beginning. You will learn the basic English word order and sentence structure in a simple and easy way, with explanations in Sinhala. 🇱🇰📖

✨ This is Part 02 of our English sentence-building series.

In this lesson, you will learn:

✅ How to make English sentences from scratch
✅ Basic English word order
✅ How to arrange English words correctly
✅ How to create simple English sentences
✅ How to understand English sentence structure
✅ How to build your own sentences instead of memorizing sentences
✅ How to think about sentence formation step by step
✅ Simple English grammar explained in Sinhala
✅ Practical English sentence patterns for everyday speaking

💡 WHY SHOULD YOU WATCH THIS VIDEO?

If you often think:

❌ “I know many English words, but I can't make sentences.”
❌ “I understand English, but I can't speak.”
❌ “I don't know where to put the words in a sentence.”
❌ “English grammar is too difficult for me.”
❌ “I always translate Sinhala sentences word by word.”

Then this video is specially made for you! 🎯

In this lesson, I will show you how to understand the logic behind English sentences. Once you understand the basic word order, you can start creating many different English sentences on your own.

🌟 You will not simply memorize one sentence.

Instead, you will learn how to use a simple structure to create many new sentences.

For example, when you understand one basic sentence pattern, you can change the subject, verb, object, time, place, and other words to create hundreds of different sentences. 🧠💬

🎓 This lesson is especially useful for:

🇱🇰 Sri Lankan beginners learning English
👨‍🎓 Students

🗣️ People who want to improve spoken English
📚 People who struggle with English grammar
🔤 Beginners who don't know how to make English sentences

▶️ Watch the video carefully.
▶️ Listen to each explanation.
▶️ Pause the video when necessary.
▶️ Repeat the sentences aloud.
▶️ Try to create your own sentences.
▶️ Watch the video several times.
▶️ Practice every day.

Remember, learning English is not about memorizing everything in one day. 🌱

The most important thing is to understand how English works and practice step by step.

title: Why do some people have EXTRA Teeth 🤐😫
description:
Sometimes teeth can grow where they shouldn’t — even in the roof of your mouth. This rare dental condition is called Hyperdontia, where the body creates extra tooth buds and produces more teeth than normal.

Key Points:
• Normal mouths grow a fixed number of teeth
• In hyperdontia, extra tooth buds form
• Additional teeth can grow anywhere in the mouth
• In rare cases, they appear in the roof of the mouth
• Dentists may remove them if they cause pain or crowding

description:
Ada Derana | ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ විශ්වසනීය හා ප්‍රමුඛතම පුවත් සපයන්නා

ජනපති සහ නීතිඥ සංගමය අතර පැවැති සාකච්ඡාවේ
නීතිඥ සංගමයේ සභාපති සිදුකළ ප්‍රකාශය
සම්පූර්ණ වීඩියෝව සහිතයි

ශ්‍රී ලංකා නීතිඥ සංගමය විසින් අගෝස්තු 12 වනදා ජනාධිපතිවරයා සමග පැවැති සාකච්ඡාවේ සම්පූර්ණ සංස්කරණය නොකළ වීඩියෝ පටිගත කිරීම ලබාදෙන ලෙස ශ්‍රී ලංකා නීතිඥ සංගමය ජනාධිපති මාධ්‍ය ඒකකයෙන් ඉල්ලීමක් කර තිබේ.

අගෝස්තු 14 වනදා යොමු කළ ලිපියකින් නීතිඥ සංගමය පෙන්වා දෙන්නේ මේ වනවිට එම සාකච්ඡාවේ වීඩියෝ පටිගත කිරීමේ කොටසක් පමණක් තමන්වෙත ලැබී ඇති බවය.

එම වීඩියෝවෙන් ලබාදී ඇත්තේ සාකච්ඡාවේ ආරම්භක සාකච්ඡාවක කොටසක් පමණක් වන අතර ඇතැම් කොටස්වල ශබ්දයද පැහැදිලි නොමැති බව එම ලිපියේ සඳහන් වෙයි.

ඒ අනුව සාකච්ඡාව පුරා සිදුවූ සියලු මැදිහත්වීම් නිරීක්ෂණ සහ ප්‍රතිචාර මෙන්ම නීතිඥ සංගමයේ නියෝජිත පිරිසේ අවසන් අදහස් ද ඇතුළත් සම්පූර්ණ සහ සංස්කරණය නොකළ වීඩියෝ පටිගත කිරීම ලබාදෙන ලෙස එම සංගමය ඉල්ලා ඇත.

එමෙන්ම හැකි හොඳම ශව්‍ය සහ දෘෂ්‍ය තත්ත්වයෙන් අදාළ වීඩියෝව ලබාදෙන ලෙසද නීතිඥ සංගමය ජනාධිපති ලේකම් කාර්යාලයෙන් ඉල්ලීමක් කර තිබේ.

අදාළ ලිපිය නීතිඥ සංගමයේ පරිපාලන ලේකම් සුරානි සමරසේකර මහත්මියගේ අත්සනින් යුතුව ජනාධිපති කාර්යාලව වෙත යොමුකර ඇත.

title: He Admitted He Was a Love Bomber.Now He's Warning Other Men.
description:
“I used to be a love bombing motherf••••r.”

Those weren’t my words. They were his.

In this video, we’re discussing a man’s public admission that he used to intentionally love bomb women, create intense emotional attachment, and leave behind broken hearts before urging other men to stop doing the same.

For many women, stories like this feel painfully familiar. Some describe being overwhelmed with affection, constant attention, future promises, and declarations of love, only to watch everything disappear once they became emotionally invested.

What exactly is love bombing? How do you recognize it? Why do so many people dismiss women’s experiences until someone admits it himself?

Let’s have an honest conversation about manipulation, relationships, accountability, and the lasting impact these experiences can have on people’s willingness to date, marry, or trust again.

I want to hear your thoughts in the comments. Have you experienced love bombing? What were the warning signs you wish you had recognized sooner?

title: ☠️🦴👁️The Blind Mind Chases After Visual Forms👁️🦴☠️රූපයට වී ගැති-  An Italianate Choral Elegy
description:
The Blind Mind Chases After Visual Forms (රූපයට වී ගැති) | Italianate Choral Elegy

☠️ The punishing march of samsara's lane simply will not end.☠️

Step into a somber, deeply meditative auditory experience where Eastern philosophical truths meet the haunting gravity of Western classical antiquity. Styled as a classical Italianate Choral Elegy, this sacred mortuary chant dissects our desperate attachment to visual sensory pleasure (Cakkhu Ayatana and Rupa).

Through layered polyphony and a mournful classical arrangement, the piece exposes how the eye traps the consciousness, fueling the burning fires of rebirth, decay, and endless grief."ජාති ගිනි, ජරා ගිනි, මරණ ගිනි උපදිනා... භව ගමන දික්වෙනා..."

📜 Mortuary Chant Lyrics / පද මාලාව:

(Verse 1: The Trap of the Eye 👁️💀)
Enslaved to passing forms, the restless eyes are born again,
රූපයට වී ගැති ඇස් ජාති හටගති
Chasing shadows endlessly through cycles of rebirth and pain.
Drowning in the search for pleasure, blind to the burning fire within,
ආස්වාදයට බැස එගිනි නොම දැකගති
We guard the sight, we build the state, where future forms begin.
තව තවත් බලන්නට ඇස රකින්නට නිති - සංකාර වඩන්නේ මතුත් ඇස් උපදිති

(Verse 2: Grasping and Friction 👁️💀)
Wanting every pleasing sight to hold and claim solely as mine,
මන වඩන රූ දසුන් මම මගේ කරගන්ට
Struggling hard to protect the dream before its quick decline.
මගේ කරගත්තොතින් එය හොඳින් රැකගන්ට
Clashing hard with jealous hands, fighting those who try to take,
උදුරගන්නට බලන උනුන් හා පොරකන්ට
Only to suffer deep within when those illusions fade and break.කැඩෙන බිඳෙනා විටදි සිදුවේය දුක්වන්ට

(Verse 3: The Torment of Vignāna 👁️💀)
Not everything the world displays remains agreeable and sweet,
පෙනෙන දේ ප්‍රිය මනාපයෙන් නැහැ තියෙන්නේ
Often it is a fearful dark and horror that we meet.
බියැති අප්‍රිය දසුන් නොවැ නිතර ගැටෙන්නේ
Plagued by the unrest of eager minds hungry for sensory storms,
නොමැත ඉස්පාසුවක් රූප සිත් (කර්ම විඥාණය) පෙළන්නේ
We wander far to touch the world, chasing after visual forms.
කොහේ හෝ සොයාගොස් රූ පස්ස කරන්නේ

(Verse 4: The Lengthened Journey 👁️💀)
The fleeting joy of sensory touch is all the blind mind needs,
සම්පස්සයෙන් ජනිත ප්‍රියැති සුඛ වේදනා -ආශ්වාදයට නම් එපමණකි උවමනා
Refueling flames of birth and death, it's sorrow that it breeds.
Blind to the heavy trail of grief, drifting where the shadows blend,
ජාති ගිනි, ජරා ගිනි, මරණ ගිනි උපදිනා
The punishing march of samsara's lane simply will not end.
දුක්ඛ දුක් නොදක්නේ, භව ගමන දික්වෙනා

description:
යුක්‍රේනය විසින් ඩ්‍රෝන යානා රැසක් යොදා ගනිමින් රුසියාවේ මොස්කව් කලාපයට අද (16) දැවැන්ත ප්‍රහාරයක් එල්ලකර තිබේ.

විදෙස් වාර්තාවන්ට අනුව එම කලාපය ඉලක්කකර යුක්‍රේනයෙන් එල්ල වූ දැවැන්තම ප්‍රහාරවලින් එකක් ලෙස මෙය සැලකේ. 

මොස්කව් ආණ්ඩුකාරවරයා පවසා ඇත්තේ, මෙම ප්‍රහාරයෙන් එක් අයෙකු මියගොස් ඇති තවත් කිහිප දෙනෙකු තුවාල ලබා ඇති බවය.

රුසියාවේ විශාලතම අන්තර්ජාල භාණ්ඩ අලෙවිකරුවා වන 'වයිල්ඩ්බෙරි' සමාගමට අයත් ගබඩාවකට එක් ප්‍රහාරයක් එල්ල වී ඇත.

අනෙක් ප්‍රහාර මොස්කව්හි ප්‍රධාන ගුවන්තොටුපළක් ආසන්නයේ පිහිටි තවත් ගබඩාවකට ඇතුළු ස්ථාන කිහිපයකට එල්ල වී තිබේ.

රුසියාවේ ආරක්ෂක අමාත්‍යාංශය පවසා සිටියේ, යුක්‍රේන ඩ්‍රෝන යානා 822කට වඩා බිම හෙළූ බවය.

title: ජූලි 26 ප්‍රභල සෙනසුරු මාරුවත් එක්ක මේ ලග්න 4ට අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම කෝටිපතියෝ වෙනවා
description:
ජූලි 26 ප්‍රභල සෙනසුරු මාරුවත් එක්ක මේ ලග්න 4ට අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම කෝටිපතියෝ වෙනවා | ඔබේ නිවසේ මේ දේවල් සිදුවෙනවා නම් ඔබේ ජීවිතේ පවා අනතුරේ | ජීවිතේ හැමදාම දුක් විඳින්නෙ නැතුව දියුණු වෙන්න මේ රහස දැනගන්න

The Voice is an international reality television singing competition franchise of Dutch origin. It is based on the reality singing competition The Voice of Holland, which was originally created by Dutch television producer John de Mol. I’ll spread the Dhamma's fragrance through every word and thought.
Awakening my mind to stay serene and bright,
I’ll dwell within the bliss of meditative light.
Honest in body, speech, and mind, I will endure,
Burning defilements down, to gain the Samsara's cure.

Yohani Live with Orchestra “Aadarei”
at Musaeus College Auditorium

Tickets available on: www.aadarei.com

For two nights only, Yohani invites you into the most intimate show of her career. Aadarei, meaning "love" in Sinhala, is a special evening at Colombo's Musaeus College Auditorium, where Yohani performs her most loved songs reimagined for live orchestral arrangement. From the global phenomenon that took her name around the world, to the ballads and anthems Sri Lanka has grown up with, every song has been rebuilt from the ground up, stripped back, dressed in strings, and performed in a way you've never heard them before. This is Yohani as you've never experienced her: grand and cinematic, yet personal and intimate. The setlist moves across Sinhala, Hindi, and English, 120 minutes of music, memory, and the songs that made her ours.
Presented by Outright Play. Strictly limited capacity, two nights, one venue, one unforgettable ensemble. Seating is allocated by ticket category. Please arrive before show start time. title: You Could Watch This Laminar Flow Forever 😮
description:
Sometimes a flowing liquid looks completely frozen —
like time itself has paused.

But it isn’t still.
It’s moving so smoothly that your eyes can’t detect the motion.

This phenomenon is called laminar flow —
when a liquid moves in perfectly ordered layers,
each particle following the one ahead of it without mixing or chaos.

In this video, discover why calm water can be more mysterious than rough waves.

✅ Learn how layered motion prevents turbulence
✅ Understand why no mixing makes the surface look motionless
✅ See how physics creates that glass-like illusion

There’s no disturbance.
No splashing.
No visible speed.

Just silent, flawless movement —
flowing right in front of you…

while looking completely still.

description:

title: Why do cast saws not cut skin? 🙄
description:
The small saw doctors use to remove casts may look dangerous, but it’s designed to protect the patient. It uses rapid side-to-side vibrations that cut hard casts but move harmlessly over soft skin.

Key Points:
• Doctors use a special tool called a Cast Saw
• It removes plaster or fiberglass casts from broken arms or legs
• The blade does not spin in circles like a normal saw
• Instead, it vibrates quickly from side to side
• Hard materials like casts break apart from the vibration
• Soft skin moves with the vibration and usually isn’t cut

"Be Going To" Sentence Pattern (Future Plans & Predictions)

Passive Voice (Made incredibly easy with Sinhala logic)

title: 🎶🌸THE FADING BLOSSOM 🥀🎶  A Song of Dhamma, Virtue, and Liberation 🌸🎶 (නෙලාගෙන ආවත් සුවඳ මල්)🌸🎶
description:
✨ "To see the Dhamma make the Truth complete..." 

Welcome to this contemplative musical reflection on impermanence, desire, and liberation. Inspired by the traditional Sri Lankan Buddhist devotional song "නෙලාගෙන ආවත් සුවඳ මල්," this track translates a profound ritual into a universal story of insight meditation (Vipassanā). 

What begins as a simple act of offering flowers at the Buddha’s feet unfolds into a poetic exploration of natural cause and effect, the psychology of the five senses (Sense Bases / Āyatana), the wheel of existence (Samsara), and the ultimate peace of Final Release (Nibbāna). 

Arranged as a Mellow Indie Folk / Cinematic Acoustic ballad, the song blends raw, grounded acoustic storytelling with the timeless wisdom of the Dhamma.

🕊️ May this music bring peace, stillness, and deep reflection to your day. 

🎵 LYRICS & CHAPTERS 🎵

✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🪷 ━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦
## THE FADING BLOSSOM - A Song of Dhamma, Virtue, and Liberation
✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🪷 ━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦

I. The Reflection
Though fragrant flowers to the Lord we bring,
Their scent and beauty fade like fleeting spring.
Why place these blossoms at the Buddha’s feet?
To see the Dhamma make the Truth complete.

II. The Cycle of Nature
Does beauty bloom by chance in random play?
As bees and butterflies take sweet nectar away.
Through their sweet aid, new seeds are brought to life,
To make the future fields-of-blossom rife.

III. The Passing of Illusion
Yet soon, the faded blossoms dry away,
Their sudden beauty falling to decay.
The fleeting senses fade into the dark;
The grand illusion leaves no further mark.

IV. The Drive of Craving
Illusive pleasures rule this worldly space,
Where craving draws all beings to the chase.
Through grasping, future life forms take root,
As kammic seeds of new arisings fruit.

V. The Sense Doors
The craving, like a flower, draws in input,
Through the five senses, to keep the illusion afoot.
The eye, the ear—all sense-faculties become,
"Sense Bases" where beings to desires succumb.

VI. The Wandering of Samsara
The seed of birth formed so, will eventually sprout,
As new life forms perturbed by deep desire step out.
There too, they cling to pleasures and carry on with the craze,
Still bound to Becoming, lost in Samsara’s race.

VII. The Act of Restraint
These plucked-off flowers are placed at the Buddha’s feet,
To His virtuous qualities, in deep devotion complete.
Just as the bloom was severed, we restrain the senses,
And merge into His Virtue as Morality commences.

VIII. Breaking the Wheel
A plucked-off flower can yield no seed to sprout,
It loses power to bring new blossoms out.
In virtuous dwelling, the senses cease to flare,
No room is left to form a seed of rebirth there.

IX. The Final Peace
Though born from past seeds in this current space,
Through virtue and stillness, deep wisdom takes place.
The Arahants dwell here, in comfort and peace,
For Final Release, till the body and mind fully cease.
✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🪷 ━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦

පැරිසිය කියන්නේ ලෝකයේ ලස්සනම නගරයක් විදියට හැමෝම හඳුන්වන තැනක්. හැබැයි මේ වෙද්දී පැරිසිය ඇතුලේ සිද්ධ වෙන දේවල් දැක්කම ඕනෑම කෙනෙක් පුදුම වෙනවා. නගරය පුරාම තියෙන පරණ ගොඩනැගිලි කඩලා දමමින්, පාරවල් හාරමින් සිද්ධ වෙන මේ මහා විනාශය පිටුපස තියෙන්නේ ලෝකයේ තියෙන දැවැන්තම යටිතල පහසුකම් ව්‍යාපෘතියක්. 19 වැනි සියවසේදී නිර්මාණය වුණු පැරිසියේ පැරණි සැලසුම් අද කාලයේ දියුණුවට ගැලපෙන්නේ නැහැ. ඒ නිසා "ග්‍රෑන්ඩ් පැරිස් එක්ස්ප්‍රස්" (Grand Paris Express) කියන අති දැවැන්ත මෙට්‍රෝ ව්‍යාපෘතිය හරහා ඔවුන් මුළු නගරයම අලුතින් නිර්මාණය කරනවා. කිලෝමීටර් 200කට වඩා දිග අලුත් දුම්රිය මාර්ග පද්ධතියක් සහ අති නවීන තාක්ෂණයෙන් යුත් මෙට්‍රෝ දුම්රියන් මේ ව්‍යාපෘතියට ඇතුළත්. විශේෂයෙන්ම නගරයට යටින් දැවැන්ත උමං හාරන යන්ත්‍ර පාවිච්චි කරලා අලුත්ම ලෝකයක් ඔවුන් හදනවා. මේ වැඩේ නිසා පැරිසියම එකම වැඩබිමක් වගේ පෙනුණත්, මේක අනාගතයේදී ලෝකයේ දියුණුම නගරය බවට පැරිසිය පත් කරන හැටි අද වීඩියෝ එකෙන් අපි විස්තරාත්මකව කතා කරනවා. පැරිසියේ මේ මහා පරිවර්තනය ගැන ඔයාලා අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම දැනගත යුතු කරුණු මෙන්න.

The Grand Paris Express is currently the largest civil engineering project in Europe, representing a monumental leap in urban development and infrastructure investment. This multi-billion euro transport logistics initiative aims to revolutionize public transit by adding over 200 kilometers of new track and 68 innovative stations. Historically, Paris relied on a 19th-century radial layout that struggled to keep pace with modern suburban expansion. Today, the integration of Line 15—a massive orbital line—is set to bridge the gap between the city center and peripheral business zones, significantly boosting the regional real estate market and the global economy. Investors and urban planners are closely watching how this project utilizes state-of-the-art tunnel-boring machines to navigate complex subterranean landscapes. This massive scale of construction directly influences international architecture, sustainable city design, and smart city technology. By modernizing its transport infrastructure, France is positioning Paris as a premier hub for international investment and global trade. The project highlights the necessity of adapting historic cities to the demands of the 21st century, ensuring economic growth and environmental sustainability. From sophisticated engineering challenges to high-level capital allocation, the Grand Paris Express serves as a case study for future mega-projects worldwide. This video analyzes the strategic planning, the financial scope, and the profound social impact of wiping out the old to build a futuristic, interconnected metropolis. Whether you are interested in civil engineering, global finance, or urban history, understanding this transformation is vital for grasping the future of European infrastructure.

But Apamithra was a remake of the Malayalam film Manichithradhazhu. Vidyasagar was the music director of the film. Thottadaharani was the art director. The beautiful painting of Chandramukhi in the film was done by a young man named Raja.

The film broke the record of Padayappa, released in 1999, and was dubbed and released in Bhojpuri as Chandramukhi Ke Hunkar.[citation needed]

This was the first Tamil film to be dubbed into German. It was released in Germany under the title Der Geisterjäger (English: The Ghost Hunters). The film was dubbed into Turkish and Hindi.


சந்திரமுகி (Chandramukhi) 2005 ஆம் ஆண்டு ஏப்ரல் மாதம் 14 ஆம் தேதியன்று வெளிவந்த தமிழ்மொழித் திரைப்படமாகும்.[1] பி. வாசு இதன் இயக்குநர் ஆவார். இப்படத்தில் ரஜினிகாந்த், நயன்தாரா, ஜோதிகா, வடிவேல் மற்றும் பிரபு நடித்துள்ளனர். இந்தப் படம் கன்னடம் படமான அபாமித்ராவின் மறு ஆக்கம் ஆகும், 
ஆனால் அபமித்ரா, மலையாளப் படமான மணிசித்ரதாழுவின் மறு ஆக்கம்காக இருந்தது.வித்தியாசாகர் இப்படத்தின் இசையமைப்பாளர் ஆவார். தோட்டாதரணி இதன் கலைஇயக்குநர் ஆவார். இத்திரைப்படத்தில் வரும் சந்திரமுகியின் அழகான ஓவியம் ராஜா என்ற இளைஞனால் வரையப் பெற்றது. 
இப்படம் 1999-ல் வெளியான படையப்பா பட வசூலை முறியடித்து சாதனை படைத்தது.[சான்று தேவை] இது போஜ்புரியில் சந்திரமுகி கெ ஹுன்கார் என்ற பெயரில் மொழிமாற்றம் செய்யப்பட்டு வெளியிடப்பட்டது.

description:

ඔබේ ජීවිතයේ විශාලතම වෙනසකට සූදානම්ද? අගෝස්තු 05 වැනිදා සිදුවන දැවැන්ත බුධ ග්‍රහ මාරුව සමග ඔබේ ලග්නයට සිදුවන සියලු දේ මෙන්න!

බුධ ග්‍රහයා කටක රාශියට පිවිසීමත් සමග රවී සහ ගුරු ග්‍රහයන් සමග ඇතිවන සුවිශේෂී ග්‍රහ සංයෝගය ලග්න 12ටම බලපාන ආකාරය මෙම වීඩියෝවෙන් විස්තරාත්මකව ගෙන එයි. ඔබේ සන්නිවේදනය, බුද්ධිය, රැකියාව, සහ පවුල් ජීවිතය ගැන නිවැරදිම පලාපල දැනගන්න. රජු (රවී), පුරෝහිතයා (ගුරු) සහ කුමාරයා (බුධ) මවගේ (සඳුගේ) නිවසට පැමිණීමෙන් නිර්මාණය වන මේ අපූරු තත්ත්වය ඔබේ අනාගතය වෙනස් කරන්නේ කෙසේදැයි සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම පැහැදිලි කර ඇත.

වීඩියෝව සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම නරඹා ඔබේ ලග්නයට හිමි ප්‍රතිඵල අවබෝධ කරගන්න. ඔබේ අදහස් පහළින් comment කරන්න. ඉදිරියටත් මෙවැනි නිවැරදි ජ්‍යොතිෂ තොරතුරු සහ පලාපල දැනගැනීමට අපගේ නාලිකාව Subscribe කර ඔබේ මිතුරන් අතරේ බෙදාගන්න (Share).

බෙල්ජියම් ඉතිහාසයේ විශාලතම ලැව්ගින්න
උඩුගුවනට දිස්වූ හැටි...

බෙල්ජියමේ මෙතෙක් වාර්තා වූ විශාලතම ලැව්ගින්න පාලනය කිරීම සඳහා හමුදාව සහ යුරෝපා සංගමය ඇතුළු රටවල් කිහිපයක් එක්ව මෙහෙයුම් ආරම්භ කර තිබේ.

බෙල්ජියමේ නැගෙනහිර ප්‍රදේශයේ පිහිටි High Fens ස්වභාවික රක්ෂිතයේ සිකුරාදා ආරම්භ වූ ලැව්ගින්න ඊයේ (15) වන විට වේගයෙන් පැතිර ගොස් තිබුණි. 

Liegeහි ආණ්ඩුකාර කාර්යාලය සඳහන් කළේ, සෙනසුරාදා පස්වරු 4.00 GMT වන විට ගින්නෙන් හෙක්ටයාර් 2,700කට (වර්ග සැතපුම් 10.4ක් පමණ) භූමි ප්‍රමාණයක් දැවී ගොස් ඇති බවය. එය එදින පෙර වාර්තා වූ හෙක්ටයාර් 1,600ක ප්‍රමාණයට වඩා සැලකිය යුතු වැඩිවීමකි.

ඒ අනුව මෙය බෙල්ජියමේ මෙතෙක් වාර්තා වූ විශාලතම ලැව්ගින්න බවට පත්ව තිබේ. මීට පෙර 2011 වසරේදී වාර්තා වූ විශාලතම ලැව්ගින්නෙන් හෙක්ටයාර් 1,400කට ආසන්න භූමි ප්‍රමාණයක් විනාශ වී තිබුණි.

ගින්න මැඩපැවැත්වීම සඳහා යුරෝපා සංගමය හෙලිකොප්ටර් 3ක් සහ ජල ප්‍රහාරක ගුවන් යානා 2ක් යොදවා ඇති අතර, ජර්මනිය සහ ලක්සම්බර්ග් ද සහාය ලබා දෙමින් සිටී. බෙල්ජියම් හමුදාවේ ගිනි නිවීමේ වාහන ද මෙහෙයුමට එක්ව තිබේ.

වෙනස්වන සුළං තත්ත්වය සහ දුම හේතුවෙන් ආසන්න ගම්මාන කිහිපයක ජනතාවට නිවෙස්වලින් ඉවත් වන ලෙස බලධාරීන් දැනුම් දී තිබේ. ප්‍රදේශයේ රැඳී සිටි සංචාරකයන්ට ද ඉවත්වන ලෙස උපදෙස් ලබාදී ඇති අතර, ළමුන් සඳහා පැවැත්වෙමින් තිබූ ගිම්හාන කඳවුරක්ද ආරක්ෂිතව ඉවත් කර තිබේ.
